quote: Currently, LAMP has been widely applied to detect pathogens in aquaculture, such as parasites, bacteria and viruses [ 28 , 29 , 30 ].
statement: 目前，LAMP已广泛应用于水产养殖中寄生虫、细菌和病毒等病原体的检测。
text_zh: 目前，LAMP已广泛应用于水产养殖中寄生虫、细菌和病毒等病原体的检测。
text_en: Currently, LAMP has been widely used in aquaculture for the detection of pathogens such as parasites, bacteria, and viruses.

quote: With the development of Chinese perch culture, co-infection of A. hydrophila and ISKNV has often become observed [ 33 ].
statement: 随着中国鳜鱼养殖业的发展，嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV的混合感染经常被观察到。
text_zh: 随着中国鳜鱼养殖业的发展，嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV的混合感染经常被观察到。
text_en: With the development of Chinese mandarin fish aquaculture, mixed infections of Aeromonas hydrophila and ISKNV are frequently observed.

quote: Under mixed infection conditions, mandarin fish exhibited severe clinical symptoms and notable histopathological alterations.
statement: 在混合感染条件下，鳜鱼表现出严重的临床症状和明显的组织病理学改变。
text_zh: 在混合感染条件下，鳜鱼表现出严重的临床症状和明显的组织病理学改变。
text_en: Under mixed infection conditions, mandarin fish exhibited severe clinical symptoms and obvious histopathological changes.

quote: The co-infection resulted in darkened body coloration, impaired swimming capacity and extensive hemorrhaging in tissues, including the gill filaments, fin base, liver, spleen and kidneys, in diseased individuals [ 34 ].
statement: 混合感染导致患病个体体色变暗、游泳能力受损以及包括鳃丝、鳍基、肝脏、脾脏和肾脏在内的组织广泛出血。
text_zh: 混合感染导致患病个体体色变暗、游泳能力受损以及包括鳃丝、鳍基、肝脏、脾脏和肾脏在内的组织广泛出血。
text_en: Mixed infection caused darkening of body color, impaired swimming ability, and widespread hemorrhage in tissues including gill filaments, fin bases, liver, spleen, and kidney in affected individuals.

quote: The sensitivity of the duplex LAMP-HNB method was measured using serial dilutions of the genomic DNA template.
statement: Duplex LAMP-HNB方法的灵敏度通过使用基因组DNA模板的系列稀释液进行测量。
text_zh: Duplex LAMP-HNB方法的灵敏度通过使用基因组DNA模板的系列稀释液进行测量。
text_en: The sensitivity of the Duplex LAMP-HNB method was measured using serial dilutions of genomic DNA templates.

quote: The duplex LAMP-HNB method enabled minimal detection of 100 fg for A. hydrophila ( Figure 5 and 100 fg for ISKNV ( Figure 6 ), and the minimum detection limit for the mixed template was 1 pg ( Figure 7 ).
statement: Duplex LAMP-HNB方法对嗜水气单胞菌的最小检测量为100 fg，对ISKNV为100 fg，混合模板的最小检测限为1 pg。
text_zh: Duplex LAMP-HNB方法对嗜水气单胞菌的最小检测量为100 fg，对ISKNV为100 fg，混合模板的最小检测限为1 pg。
text_en: The minimum detection limit of the Duplex LAMP-HNB method is 100 fg for Aeromonas hydrophila, 100 fg for ISKNV, and 1 pg for mixed templates.

quote: The sensitivity of this method is better than that Gao Z. et al. established for the detection of A. hydrophila , with a minimum detection limit of 0.559 ng/μL; the article also lists a qPCR assay with a minimum detection limit of 4.301 ng/μL [ 43 ].
statement: 该方法的灵敏度优于Gao Z.等人建立的嗜水气单胞菌检测方法（最小检测限0.559 ng/μL），也优于列出的qPCR检测方法（最小检测限4.301 ng/μL）。
text_zh: 该方法的灵敏度优于Gao Z.等人建立的嗜水气单胞菌检测方法（最小检测限0.559 ng/μL），也优于列出的qPCR检测方法（最小检测限4.301 ng/μL）。
text_en: The sensitivity of this method is superior to the Aeromonas hydrophila detection method established by Gao Z. et al. (minimum detection limit 0.559 ng/μL), and also superior to the listed qPCR detection methods (minimum detection limit 4.301 ng/μL).

quote: In summary, a method for the detection of A. hydrophila and ISKNV co-infection by duplex LAMP-HNB was established in this paper, which has good sensitivity and specificity.
statement: 总之，本文建立了一种通过双链LAMP-HNB检测嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV混合感染的方法，具有良好的敏感性和特异性。
text_zh: 总之，本文建立了一种通过双链LAMP-HNB检测嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV混合感染的方法，具有良好的敏感性和特异性。
text_en: In summary, this paper established a method for detecting Aeromonas hydrophila and ISKNV mixed infections using double-stranded LAMP-HNB, which has good sensitivity and specificity.

population.species: 鳜鱼 (隐含于上下文 'mandarin fish')

quote: The analysis can be completed quickly, and due to the simple method and fast process, it can be used for early detection or preliminary screening of common pathogens in mandarin fish, which is conducive to preventing the spread of the pathogens in the farm.
statement: 由于方法简单且过程快速，该分析可迅速完成，可用于鳜鱼常见病原体的早期检测或初步筛查，有利于防止病原体在养殖场中的传播。
text_zh: 由于方法简单且过程快速，该分析可迅速完成，可用于鳜鱼常见病原体的早期检测或初步筛查，有利于防止病原体在养殖场中的传播。
text_en: Due to its simple method and rapid process, this analysis can be completed quickly and can be used for the early detection or preliminary screening of common pathogens in mandarin fish, which is beneficial for preventing the spread of pathogens in aquaculture farms.

quote: Fish were kept in aquarias with a flowthrough water system and aerated freshwater at 29 °C.
statement: 鱼类被饲养在具有流水系统和充氧淡水的鱼缸中，温度为29°C。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在具有流水系统和充氧淡水的鱼缸中，温度为29°C。
text_en: Fish were reared in aquaria with a flow-through system and oxygenated freshwater at a temperature of 29°C.

quote: No fish treated with LPS or Poly (I:C) died
statement: 接受LPS或Poly(I:C)处理的鱼没有死亡。
text_zh: 接受LPS或Poly(I:C)处理的鱼没有死亡。
text_en: Fish treated with LPS or Poly(I:C) did not die.

quote: The detection method developed in this study is capable of effectively identifying low-level infections of A. hydrophila and ISKNV, facilitating the recognition of early or subclinical infections, enabling early warning for disease prevention and control and mitigating risks in aquaculture practices.
statement: 本研究开发的检测方法能够有效识别嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的低位感染，有助于早期或亚临床感染的识别，实现疾病防控的预警并降低水产养殖风险。
text_zh: 本研究开发的检测方法能够有效识别嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的低位感染，有助于早期或亚临床感染的识别，实现疾病防控的预警并降低水产养殖风险。
text_en: The detection method developed in this study can effectively identify low-level infections of Aeromonas hydrophila and infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus, helping to identify early or subclinical infections, enabling disease prevention and control warnings, and reducing aquaculture risks.

quote: The detection method developed by Lin et al., based on dualplex RAA and CRISPR/Cas12a for pathogenic A. hydrophila , demonstrates high sensitivity, with a minimum detection limit of two copies of genomic DNA. However, the interpretation and differentiation of its results depend on the use of precision instruments.
statement: Lin等人基于双重RAA和CRISPR/Cas12a开发的针对致病性嗜水气单胞菌的检测方法显示出高灵敏度，最低检测限为两个拷贝的基因组DNA，但其结果的解释和区分依赖于精密仪器的使用。
text_zh: Lin等人基于双重RAA和CRISPR/Cas12a开发的针对致病性嗜水气单胞菌的检测方法显示出高灵敏度，最低检测限为两个拷贝的基因组DNA，但其结果的解释和区分依赖于精密仪器的使用。
text_en: The detection method for pathogenic Aeromonas hydrophila developed by Lin et al. based on dual RAA and CRISPR/Cas12a showed high sensitivity, with a limit of detection of two copies of genomic DNA, but the interpretation and differentiation of its results relied on the use of sophisticated instruments.
outcome: 检测灵敏度与设备依赖

quote: The TaqMan PCR assay established by Trakhna F. et al. had a detection limit of 1 pg for DNA from A. hydrophila, but it is limited by the reliance on precision instruments [ 49 ].
statement: Trakhna F.等人建立的TaqMan PCR测定法对嗜水气单胞菌DNA的检测限为1 pg，但受限于对精密仪器的依赖。
text_zh: Trakhna F.等人建立的TaqMan PCR测定法对嗜水气单胞菌DNA的检测限为1 pg，但受限于对精密仪器的依赖。
text_en: The TaqMan PCR assay established by Trakhna F. et al. has a detection limit of 1 pg for Aeromonas hydrophila DNA, but is limited by its dependence on precision instruments.
outcome: 检测灵敏度与设备依赖

quote: SCRV can survive for months in liquids at moderate temperatures so that has caused high morbidity and mortality in fish (Xu et al., 2023).
statement: SCRV病毒在中等温度的液体中可存活数月，导致鱼类高发病率和死亡率。
text_zh: SCRV病毒在中等温度的液体中可存活数月，导致鱼类高发病率和死亡率。
text_en: SCRV virus can survive for months in liquid at moderate temperatures, leading to high morbidity and mortality in fish.

quote: Fish rhabdovirus has a diverse set of reservoirs, numerous strains, and high virulence, which seriously endangering fish health, and is one of the important causes of viral diseases in fish farming (Fu et al., 2017).
statement: 鱼类弹状病毒具有多种宿主、众多毒株和高致病性，严重危害鱼类健康，是水产养殖中病毒性疾病的重要原因之一。
text_zh: 鱼类弹状病毒具有多种宿主、众多毒株和高致病性，严重危害鱼类健康，是水产养殖中病毒性疾病的重要原因之一。
text_en: Fish rhabdoviruses have multiple hosts, numerous strains, and high pathogenicity, seriously endangering fish health and being one of the important causes of viral diseases in aquaculture.

quote: After infection with the virus of this genus, the symptoms of the fish are drowsiness, enlargement of the abdomen, and bleeding from the liver, spleen and skin (Ma et al., 2013, Ou et al., 2013, Luo et al., 2013, Huang et al., 2021).
statement: 感染该属病毒后，鱼类的症状包括嗜睡、腹部肿大以及肝、脾和皮肤出血。
text_zh: 感染该属病毒后，鱼类的症状包括嗜睡、腹部肿大以及肝、脾和皮肤出血。
text_en: After infection with viruses of this genus, fish symptoms include lethargy, abdominal swelling, and hemorrhage in the liver, spleen, and skin.

quote: After 5 weeks feeding trial, all the fishes were starved for 24 h and euthanized with MS-222 (Argent Chemical Laboratories, Redmond, WA, USA), and then weighted and counted.
statement: 在为期5周的饲养试验后，所有鱼被禁食24小时，并使用MS-222进行安乐死，随后称重和计数。
text_zh: 在为期5周的饲养试验后，所有鱼被禁食24小时，并使用MS-222进行安乐死，随后称重和计数。
text_en: After a 5-week feeding trial, all fish were fasted for 24 hours and euthanized using MS-222, followed by weighing and counting.

quote: However, Chinese perch owns a peculiar feeding habit, only after acclimation with a standard training protocol, could they accept artificial diets smoothly
statement: 鳜鱼具有特殊的摄食习性，只有经过标准训练方案的驯化后，才能顺利接受人工饲料。
text_zh: 鳜鱼具有特殊的摄食习性，只有经过标准训练方案的驯化后，才能顺利接受人工饲料。
text_en: Mandarin fish have special feeding habits; they can only smoothly accept artificial feed after being domesticated through a standard training program.

quote: Excess dietary fat, on the other hand, would also cause fatty degeneration, hepatic inflammation and fatty liver syndrome, and then caused an adverse effect on its health and carcass quality.
statement: 过量的日粮脂肪会导致脂肪变性、肝脏炎症和脂肪肝综合征，进而对其健康和胴体品质产生不利影响。
text_zh: 过量的日粮脂肪会导致脂肪变性、肝脏炎症和脂肪肝综合征，进而对其健康和胴体品质产生不利影响。
text_en: Excess dietary fat leads to steatosis, liver inflammation, and fatty liver syndrome, thereby adversely affecting their health and carcass quality.

quote: Within certain limit, the increase of dietary fat in L7 and L12 group was propitious to reduce the consumption of protein and improve growth performance in Chinese perch.
statement: 在一定限度内，L7和L12组日粮脂肪含量的增加有利于减少蛋白质消耗并改善鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_zh: 在一定限度内，L7和L12组日粮脂肪含量的增加有利于减少蛋白质消耗并改善鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_en: Within a certain limit, increasing dietary fat content in the L7 and L12 groups is beneficial for reducing protein consumption and improving the growth performance of Chinese perch.
limitations: 仅在特定剂量范围（L7和L12组）有效

quote: Both the increase of lipogenesis and the absence of FAs β-oxidation in L17 group could trigger the esterification of FAs, indeed, the inhibition of gluconeogenesis could also aggravate triglyceride accumulation in liver and induce hepatic steatosis.
statement: L17组中脂质生成的增加和脂肪酸β-氧化的缺失可能触发脂肪酸酯化，且糖异生的抑制也会加剧肝脏甘油三酯积累并诱导肝脂肪变性。
text_zh: L17组中脂质生成的增加和脂肪酸β-氧化的缺失可能触发脂肪酸酯化，且糖异生的抑制也会加剧肝脏甘油三酯积累并诱导肝脂肪变性。
text_en: The increase in lipid synthesis and the lack of fatty acid β-oxidation in the L17 group may trigger fatty acid esterification, and the inhibition of gluconeogenesis also exacerbates hepatic triglyceride accumulation and induces hepatic steatosis.
outcome: 肝脏健康与脂质代谢紊乱

quote: However, high fat diets led to the increased fat deposition in fish body, induced metabolic impairments including fatty liver syndrome [ 9 ], abnormal oxidative status [ 10 ], and altered nutritional value, organoleptic and physical properties [ 6 ].
statement: 然而，高脂日粮导致鱼体脂肪沉积增加，引发包括脂肪肝综合征、异常氧化状态以及营养价值、感官和物理特性改变在内的代谢障碍。
text_zh: 然而，高脂日粮导致鱼体脂肪沉积增加，引发包括脂肪肝综合征、异常氧化状态以及营养价值、感官和物理特性改变在内的代谢障碍。
text_en: However, high-fat diets led to increased fat deposition in fish bodies, triggering metabolic disorders including fatty liver syndrome, abnormal oxidative status, and changes in nutritional value, sensory, and physical properties.

quote: Prior to experiment, all the fish would accept the artificial diets after acclimation
statement: 实验前，鳜鱼经过驯化后能够接受人工饲料。
text_zh: 实验前，鳜鱼经过驯化后能够接受人工饲料。
text_en: Before the experiment, mandarin fish were able to accept artificial feed after acclimation.

quote: Four diets were formulated with different gradient lipid (2, 7, 12 and 17%, respectively) and coded as L2, L7, L12, and L17 group
statement: 配制了四种不同脂肪水平（分别为2%、7%、12%和17%）的日粮。
text_zh: 配制了四种不同脂肪水平（分别为2%、7%、12%和17%）的日粮。
text_en: Four diets with different fat levels (2%, 7%, 12%, and 17%) were formulated.

quote: The stocking density was 12 fishes (44.50 ± 0.25 g fish − 1 ) per tank
statement: 每个水箱的放养密度为12尾鱼（单尾重44.50 ± 0.25克）。
text_zh: 每个水箱的放养密度为12尾鱼（单尾重44.50 ± 0.25克）。
text_en: The stocking density per tank was 12 fish (individual weight 44.50 ± 0.25 g).

quote: all the fish were fed twice a day at 8.30 am and 17.30 pm to apparent satiation
statement: 所有鱼每天上午8:30和下午5:30投喂两次，直至表观饱食。
text_zh: 所有鱼每天上午8:30和下午5:30投喂两次，直至表观饱食。
text_en: All fish were fed twice daily, at 8:30 AM and 5:30 PM, until apparent satiation.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 24 ± 2 °C, and the water was changed twice a week by using circulating water system.
statement: 水温维持在24±2°C，并使用循环水系统每周换水两次。
text_zh: 水温维持在24±2°C，并使用循环水系统每周换水两次。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 24±2°C, and a recirculating water system was used to change the water twice a week.
intervention: Temperature control and regular water changes

quote: From L2 to L12 group, the food intake (FI) showed no significant difference, but the final weight (FW), weight gain (WG), specific growth ratio (SGR) and protein retention (PR) were progressively elevated.
statement: 从L2组到L12组，摄食量无显著差异，但终重、增重率、特定生长率和蛋白质保留率逐渐升高。
text_zh: 从L2组到L12组，摄食量无显著差异，但终重、增重率、特定生长率和蛋白质保留率逐渐升高。
text_en: From the L2 group to the L12 group, there was no significant difference in feed intake, but final weight, weight gain rate, specific growth rate, and protein retention rate gradually increased.

quote: All of the above indices were decreased markedly in L17 group compared to L12 group.
statement: 与L12组相比，L17组的上述所有指标均显著下降。
text_zh: 与L12组相比，L17组的上述所有指标均显著下降。
text_en: Compared with the L12 group, all of the above indicators in the L17 group decreased significantly.

quote: Serum glucose concentration was increased progressively from L2 to L12 group, but decreased sharply in L17 group.
statement: 血清葡萄糖浓度从L2组到L12组逐渐增加，但在L17组急剧下降。
text_zh: 血清葡萄糖浓度从L2组到L12组逐渐增加，但在L17组急剧下降。
text_en: Serum glucose concentration gradually increased from the L2 group to the L12 group, but sharply decreased in the L17 group.

quote: Four isonitrogenous diets with different fat levels (2, 7, 12 and 17%) were formulated, named L2, L7, L12 and L17 respectively, and fed Chinese perch (44.50 ± 0.25 g) to apparent satiation for five weeks.
statement: 配制了四种等氮但脂肪水平不同（2%、7%、12%和17%）的饲料，分别命名为L2、L7、L12和L17，并投喂鳜鱼至表观饱食状态持续五周。
text_zh: 配制了四种等氮但脂肪水平不同（2%、7%、12%和17%）的饲料，分别命名为L2、L7、L12和L17，并投喂鳜鱼至表观饱食状态持续五周。
text_en: Four iso-nitrogenous diets with different lipid levels (2%, 7%, 12%, and 17%), named L2, L7, L12, and L17, were formulated and fed to mandarin fish to apparent satiation for five weeks.

quote: The maximal growth performance and food intake were observed in L12 group.
statement: 在L12组中观察到最大的生长性能和采食量。
text_zh: 在L12组中观察到最大的生长性能和采食量。
text_en: The greatest growth performance and feed intake were observed in the L12 group.

quote: Histology analysis also demonstrated that mass lipid droplets emerged in hepatocyte and then induced hepatic steatosis in L17 group.
statement: 组织学分析还表明，在L17组中肝细胞内出现大量脂滴，随后诱导了脂肪肝变性。
text_zh: 组织学分析还表明，在L17组中肝细胞内出现大量脂滴，随后诱导了脂肪肝变性。
text_en: Histological analysis also showed that a large number of lipid droplets appeared in hepatocytes in the L17 group, subsequently inducing fatty liver degeneration.

quote: Indeed, the H E staining showed that liver cells appeared small vacuoles progressively from L2 group to L12 group, but in L17 group, the vacuole was enlarged sharply and then squeezed the cell nuclei to the edge
statement: HE染色显示，从L2组到L12组肝细胞逐渐出现小空泡，但在L17组中空泡急剧增大并将细胞核挤压至边缘。
text_zh: HE染色显示，从L2组到L12组肝细胞逐渐出现小空泡，但在L17组中空泡急剧增大并将细胞核挤压至边缘。
text_en: HE staining showed that small vacuoles gradually appeared in hepatocytes from the L2 group to the L12 group, but in the L17 group the vacuoles increased sharply and pushed the nucleus to the periphery.

quote: The relative area of lipid droplet in L17 group was significantly larger than other groups, on the other hand, the number of cell nuclei was descended only in L17 group
statement: L17组的脂滴相对面积显著大于其他组，另一方面，仅在L17组中细胞核数量下降。
text_zh: L17组的脂滴相对面积显著大于其他组，另一方面，仅在L17组中细胞核数量下降。
text_en: The relative area of lipid droplets in the L17 group was significantly larger than that in other groups; on the other hand, a decrease in the number of cell nuclei occurred only in the L17 group.

quote: That means liver cells had suffered from pathological reaction which was induced by TG infiltration.
statement: 这意味着肝细胞遭受了由甘油三酯浸润诱导的病理反应。
text_zh: 这意味着肝细胞遭受了由甘油三酯浸润诱导的病理反应。
text_en: This means that hepatocytes suffered a pathological response induced by triglyceride infiltration.

quote: In addition, the AST enzymatic activity in blood, a maker of hepatic injury, was significantly elevated in L17 group compared with other groups
statement: 此外，作为肝损伤标志物的血液中AST酶活性在L17组中与其他组相比显著升高。
text_zh: 此外，作为肝损伤标志物的血液中AST酶活性在L17组中与其他组相比显著升高。
text_en: In addition, blood AST enzyme activity, as a marker of liver damage, was significantly higher in the L17 group compared to other groups.

quote: This model would be better for the homeostasis of TG pool and the stabilization of physiological status of Chinese perch.
statement: 该模型更有利于鳜鱼甘油三酯池的稳态和生理状态的稳定。
text_zh: 该模型更有利于鳜鱼甘油三酯池的稳态和生理状态的稳定。
text_en: This model is more conducive to the homeostasis of the triglyceride pool and the stability of physiological status in mandarin fish.

quote: L7 and L12 represent diets containing of 7 and 12% lipid content, which was the optimal range of lipid level for fish growth and utilization in the present study.
statement: L7和L12代表含有7%和12%脂质含量的日粮，这是本研究中鱼类生长和利用的最佳脂质水平范围。
text_zh: L7和L12代表含有7%和12%脂质含量的日粮，这是本研究中鱼类生长和利用的最佳脂质水平范围。
text_en: L7 and L12 represent diets containing 7% and 12% lipid content, which is the optimal range of lipid levels for fish growth and utilization in this study.

quote: Surprisingly, both the HSI and the hepatic TG content were significant higher in L17 group.
statement: 令人惊讶的是，L17组（17%脂肪）的肝体比和肝脏甘油三酯含量均显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 令人惊讶的是，L17组（17%脂肪）的肝体比和肝脏甘油三酯含量均显著高于对照组。
text_en: Surprisingly, the hepatosomatic index and liver triglyceride content in the L17 group (17% fat) were both significantly higher than those in the control group.

quote: The relative area of lipid droplets and the size of vacuoles in hepatocyte were increased and enlarged separately in L17 group. That means ectopic fat deposition and hepatic steatosis in hepatocyte [ 56 ].
statement: L17组肝细胞中脂滴相对面积和空泡大小分别增加和扩大，这意味着发生了异位脂肪沉积和肝细胞脂肪变性。
text_zh: L17组肝细胞中脂滴相对面积和空泡大小分别增加和扩大，这意味着发生了异位脂肪沉积和肝细胞脂肪变性。
text_en: In the L17 group, the relative area of lipid droplets and the size of vacuoles in hepatocytes increased and enlarged, respectively, indicating ectopic fat deposition and hepatic steatosis.

quote: The higher enzymic activity of AST indicated that hepatic injury was caused by TG infiltration in hepatocyte [ 57 ].
statement: AST酶活性升高表明肝细胞中的TG浸润导致了肝脏损伤。
text_zh: AST酶活性升高表明肝细胞中的TG浸润导致了肝脏损伤。
text_en: Elevated AST enzyme activity indicates that TG infiltration in hepatocytes led to liver damage.

quote: Similar reports have confirmed that excess fat-intake would induce TG deposition and cause hepatic impairment in some aquaculture fish species [ 26 , 55 , 58 , 59 ].
statement: 类似的报告证实，过量脂肪摄入会在某些养殖鱼类中诱导TG沉积并导致肝功能损害。
text_zh: 类似的报告证实，过量脂肪摄入会在某些养殖鱼类中诱导TG沉积并导致肝功能损害。
text_en: Similar reports confirm that excessive fat intake induces TG deposition and leads to liver function damage in certain farmed fish.

quote: The results demonstrated that after four weeks of treatment, all experimental groups experienced full compensatory growth and reached the control group weight.
statement: 在为期四周的处理后，所有实验组均实现了完全补偿性生长并达到了对照组的体重。
text_zh: 在为期四周的处理后，所有实验组均实现了完全补偿性生长并达到了对照组的体重。
text_en: After a four-week treatment period, all experimental groups achieved complete compensatory growth and reached the body weight of the control group.

quote: Specific growth rate, feeding rate, and feed efficiency in all fasting groups were significantly higher than those of the control after the first 2 weeks of food resupply.
statement: 在恢复喂食的前两周内，所有禁食组的特定生长率、摄食率和饲料效率均显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在恢复喂食的前两周内，所有禁食组的特定生长率、摄食率和饲料效率均显著高于对照组。
text_en: In the first two weeks of resumed feeding, the specific growth rate, feed intake rate, and feed efficiency of all fasting groups were significantly higher than those of the control group.

quote: At the end of fasting, the lipid content, ratio of lipid to lean body mass, hepatosomatic and viscerosomatic indices in all fasting groups, or total cholesterol content in F14 significantly decreased compared to the control.
statement: 在禁食结束时，所有禁食组的脂质含量、脂质与瘦体重比率、肝体比和脏体比，或F14组的总胆固醇含量均显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在禁食结束时，所有禁食组的脂质含量、脂质与瘦体重比率、肝体比和脏体比，或F14组的总胆固醇含量均显著低于对照组。
text_en: At the end of fasting, lipid content, lipid-to-lean body mass ratio, hepatosomatic index, and viscerosomatic index were significantly lower in all fasting groups than in the control group, or total cholesterol content was significantly lower in the F14 group.

quote: However, high-fat diet in L17 group could easily impair hepatic lipid homeostasis and induce lipid metabolic disorder, which was caused by the absence of lipolysis and the aggravation of lipogenesis.
statement: 然而，L17组的高脂日粮容易损害肝脏脂质稳态并诱导脂质代谢紊乱，这是由脂解缺失和脂肪生成加剧引起的。
text_zh: 然而，L17组的高脂日粮容易损害肝脏脂质稳态并诱导脂质代谢紊乱，这是由脂解缺失和脂肪生成加剧引起的。
text_en: However, the high-fat diet in the L17 group easily damages hepatic lipid homeostasis and induces lipid metabolic disorders, which are caused by a lack of lipolysis and exacerbated lipogenesis.

quote: Both the hepatic injury and the decrease of serum glucose could impair the normal physiological status and slow the growth rate in Chinese perch.
statement: 肝损伤和血清葡萄糖降低都会损害鳜鱼的正常生理状态并减缓其生长速度。
text_zh: 肝损伤和血清葡萄糖降低都会损害鳜鱼的正常生理状态并减缓其生长速度。
text_en: Liver damage and decreased serum glucose both impair the normal physiological state of mandarin fish and slow down their growth rate.

quote: Nevertheless, the acute decline in growth rate, food intake and protein retention were observed only in L17 group.
statement: 然而，仅在L17组观察到生长率、摄食量和蛋白质保留率的急剧下降。
text_zh: 然而，仅在L17组观察到生长率、摄食量和蛋白质保留率的急剧下降。
text_en: However, a sharp decline in growth rate, feed intake, and protein retention was observed only in the L17 group.
outcome: 生长率、摄食量与蛋白质保留

quote: It was indicated that excess fat-intake could result in the poor growth performance, anorexia symptoms and even lipid metabolic disorders
statement: 有迹象表明，过量摄入脂肪可能导致生长性能差、厌食症状甚至脂质代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 有迹象表明，过量摄入脂肪可能导致生长性能差、厌食症状甚至脂质代谢紊乱。
text_en: There are indications that excessive fat intake may lead to poor growth performance, anorexia symptoms, and even lipid metabolism disorders.
outcome: 生长性能、食欲与代谢健康

quote: Within certain limit, the variation of dietary fat level from 2 to 12%, could not influence the homeostasis of hepatic lipid according to the TG content in liver and serum.
statement: 在特定限度内，日粮脂肪水平从2%到12%的变化，根据肝脏和血清中的甘油三酯含量来看，不会影响肝脏脂质的稳态。
text_zh: 在特定限度内，日粮脂肪水平从2%到12%的变化，根据肝脏和血清中的甘油三酯含量来看，不会影响肝脏脂质的稳态。
text_en: Within certain limits, changes in dietary fat levels from 2% to 12% do not affect hepatic lipid homeostasis, as indicated by triglyceride content in the liver and serum.

quote: Similar results had been reported in other fishes, like grass carp [ 10 , 14 , 17 ], Nile tilapia [ 12 ], Atlantic halibut ( Hippoglossus hippolossus ) [ 16 ], sea bream ( Diplodus sargus ) [ 49 ] and meagre ( Argyrosomus regius ) [ 4 ].
statement: 其他鱼类如草鱼、尼罗罗非鱼、大西洋庸鲽、鲷和石首鱼中也报道了类似的结果。
text_zh: 其他鱼类如草鱼、尼罗罗非鱼、大西洋庸鲽、鲷和石首鱼中也报道了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results have been reported in other fish such as grass carp, Nile tilapia, Atlantic halibut, sea bream and croaker.

population.species: grass carp; Nile tilapia; Atlantic halibut; sea bream; meagre

quote: Meanwhile, the histomorphology of hepatocyte showed that small vacuoles and lipid droplets were emerged progressively in L7 and L12 group, which demonstrated that plasma lipid could pass in liver frequently through esterification of FFAs [ 50 , 51 ].
statement: 肝细胞组织形态学显示，L7和L12组中逐渐出现小空泡和脂滴，这表明血浆脂质可以通过游离脂肪酸的酯化频繁进入肝脏。
text_zh: 肝细胞组织形态学显示，L7和L12组中逐渐出现小空泡和脂滴，这表明血浆脂质可以通过游离脂肪酸的酯化频繁进入肝脏。
text_en: Hepatocyte histomorphology showed the gradual appearance of small vacuoles and lipid droplets in the L7 and L12 groups, indicating that plasma lipids can frequently enter the liver through the esterification of free fatty acids.

quote: Additionally, numerous studies have aimed to standardize rearing patterns through the application of limited food supply methods for reducing stress due to various unpredictable yet frequent events (e.g., environmental degradation, high/low water temperatures, disease, handling, etc.), thereby developing appropriate feeding regimes for realistic aquaculture settings
statement: 许多研究旨在通过应用限制食物供应方法来标准化养殖模式，以减少由各种不可预测但频繁发生的事件（如环境退化、高/低水温、疾病、处理等）引起的应激。
text_zh: 许多研究旨在通过应用限制食物供应方法来标准化养殖模式，以减少由各种不可预测但频繁发生的事件（如环境退化、高/低水温、疾病、处理等）引起的应激。
text_en: Many studies aim to standardize farming patterns by applying food restriction methods to reduce stress caused by various unpredictable but frequent events (such as environmental degradation, high/low water temperatures, disease, handling, etc.).

quote: It has been established that fish growth and feeding efficiency depend on food quantity and quality [ 23 , 24 ], which, in turn, are dependent on the rearing environment, food composition, form, and feeding method [ 25 , 26 ].
statement: 已确立鱼类生长和饲料效率取决于食物的数量和质量，而这些又取决于养殖环境、食物成分、形态和喂养方法。
text_zh: 已确立鱼类生长和饲料效率取决于食物的数量和质量，而这些又取决于养殖环境、食物成分、形态和喂养方法。
text_en: It is established that fish growth and feed efficiency depend on the quantity and quality of food, which in turn depend on the farming environment, food composition, morphology, and feeding methods.

quote: Prior to the experiment, all the fish in each group were fasted for 24 h for gut evacuation, followed by anesthesia with a 2-phenoxyethanol solution (150 mg L −1 ; Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA) to minimize the stress before body weight and body length measurement.
statement: 在实验前，鱼群禁食24小时以排空肠道，随后使用150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液进行麻醉，以尽量减少测量体重和体长前的应激。
text_zh: 在实验前，鱼群禁食24小时以排空肠道，随后使用150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液进行麻醉，以尽量减少测量体重和体长前的应激。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were fasted for 24 hours to empty their intestines, then anesthetized with a 150 mg/L solution of 2-phenoxyethanol to minimize stress before measuring body weight and body length.

quote: Fish were anesthetized in 150 mg/L of 2-phenoxyethanol solution for 1 min after the measurement of body weight or body length.
statement: 在测量体重或体长后，鱼在150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液中麻醉1分钟。
text_zh: 在测量体重或体长后，鱼在150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液中麻醉1分钟。
text_en: After measuring body weight or body length, the fish were anesthetized for 1 minute in a 2-phenoxyethanol solution at 150 mg/L.

quote: The fiberglass circular tanks were aerated to provide sufficient dissolved oxygen
statement: Fiberglass circular tanks were aerated to ensure sufficient dissolved oxygen levels.
text_en: Fiberglass circular tanks were aerated to ensure sufficient dissolved oxygen levels.

quote: water temperature, ammonia, nitrous acid, and pH were monitored daily
statement: Water parameters including temperature, ammonia, nitrous acid, and pH were monitored daily.
text_en: Water parameters including temperature, ammonia, nitrous acid, and pH were monitored daily.

quote: Experimental temperatures ranged from 26.4 to 27.5 °C, dissolved oxygen concentrations were ≥7.6 mg L −1 , ammonia concentration was ≤0.35 mg L −1 , nitrous acid concentration was ≤0.18 mg L −1 , and pH ranged from 6.7 to 7.3 comparable with previous studies [ 26 , 31 , 32 ].
statement: 实验期间的水温、溶解氧、氨氮、亚硝酸盐和pH值均维持在特定范围内，且与先前研究相当。
text_zh: 实验期间的水温、溶解氧、氨氮、亚硝酸盐和pH值均维持在特定范围内，且与先前研究相当。
text_en: During the experimental period, water temperature, dissolved oxygen, ammonia nitrogen, nitrite, and pH were maintained within specific ranges and were comparable to previous studies.

quote: The following growth parameters were calculated: specific growth rate (SGR, % d −1 ) = 100 × (lnW f − lnW i )/t, feeding rate (FR, % body weight d −1 = 100 × C/[(W f + W i )/2]/t, and feed efficiency (FE, %) = 100 = (W f − W i )/C where W f and W i are final and initial weights (g), t is the feeding duration (day) and C is total feed consumption (g) during t days.
statement: 研究计算了比生长速率（SGR）、摄食率（FR）和饲料效率（FE），其公式基于最终体重、初始体重、总摄食量和喂养持续时间。
text_zh: 研究计算了比生长速率（SGR）、摄食率（FR）和饲料效率（FE），其公式基于最终体重、初始体重、总摄食量和喂养持续时间。
text_en: The study calculated specific growth rate (SGR), feeding rate (FR), and feed efficiency (FE), with formulas based on final weight, initial weight, total feed intake, and feeding duration.

quote: Repeated measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) with one factor was used to determine the effects of four feeding groups on body weight from week 2 to week 8 and on SGR, FR and FE from week 3 to week 8.
statement: 使用重复测量协方差分析（ANCOVA）来确定四个饲喂组对第2周至第8周体重以及第3周至第8周SGR、FR和FE的影响。
text_zh: 使用重复测量协方差分析（ANCOVA）来确定四个饲喂组对第2周至第8周体重以及第3周至第8周SGR、FR和FE的影响。
text_en: Repeated measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) was used to determine the effects of four feeding groups on body weight from week 2 to week 8, and on SGR, FR, and FE from week 3 to week 8.

quote: These results indicated that juvenile leopard mandarin fish subjected to 5–14 days of food deprivation could achieve full compensatory growth after feeding resumption for 4 weeks and that the morphological and biochemical indices, as well as body and blood composition, remained comparable to the control group after the completion of the study under our experimental conditions.
statement: 结果表明，经历5至14天食物剥夺的幼年鳜鱼在恢复喂食4周后能够实现完全补偿生长，且在研究结束后其形态和生化指标以及身体和血液成分与对照组相当。
text_zh: 结果表明，经历5至14天食物剥夺的幼年鳜鱼在恢复喂食4周后能够实现完全补偿生长，且在研究结束后其形态和生化指标以及身体和血液成分与对照组相当。
text_en: The results showed that juvenile mandarin fish subjected to food deprivation for 5 to 14 days achieved complete compensatory growth after 4 weeks of refeeding, and at the end of the study their morphological and biochemical indicators as well as body and blood composition were comparable to those of the control group.
outcome: 生长性能与健康状态恢复

quote: Fish farmers employ fasting or limited feeding strategies in short- and long-term durations to reduce mortality or stress during water quality degradation, disease outbreaks, sorting, transferring, or harvesting or to simply improve feeding efficiency and reduce costs
statement: 渔民采用短期或长期的禁食或限饲策略，以在水质恶化、疾病爆发、分选、转移或收获期间降低死亡率或应激，或仅为了提高饲喂效率并降低成本。
text_zh: 渔民采用短期或长期的禁食或限饲策略，以在水质恶化、疾病爆发、分选、转移或收获期间降低死亡率或应激，或仅为了提高饲喂效率并降低成本。
text_en: Fishermen adopt short-term or long-term fasting or feed restriction strategies to reduce mortality or stress during water quality deterioration, disease outbreaks, sorting, transfer, or harvesting, or solely to improve feeding efficiency and reduce costs.

quote: In contrast to fish fed continuously, those subjected to restricted feeding or fasting can experience greater growth once satiation feeding is resumed
statement: 与持续投喂的鱼相比，经过限制投喂或禁食的鱼在恢复饱食投喂后可能会经历更快的生长。
text_zh: 与持续投喂的鱼相比，经过限制投喂或禁食的鱼在恢复饱食投喂后可能会经历更快的生长。
text_en: Compared to fish that are continuously fed, fish that have undergone restricted feeding or fasting may experience faster growth after resuming ad libitum feeding.
intervention_record: 限饲或禁食后恢复饱食

quote: Depending on the target species, compensatory growth efficiency can vary with type, duration, and intensity of fasting performed prior to food resupply
statement: 根据目标物种的不同，补偿生长的效率可能因重新供食前进行的禁食类型、持续时间和强度而异。
text_zh: 根据目标物种的不同，补偿生长的效率可能因重新供食前进行的禁食类型、持续时间和强度而异。
text_en: Depending on the target species, the efficiency of compensatory growth may vary according to the type, duration and intensity of fasting performed before refeeding.

quote: Before sacrificing the fish, blood samples of the fish were collected from the tail artery using a heparinized syringe following anesthesia with 2-phenoxyethanol solution (150 mg L −1 ).
statement: 在处死鱼之前，在使用150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液麻醉后，使用肝素化注射器从尾动脉采集血液样本。
text_zh: 在处死鱼之前，在使用150 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇溶液麻醉后，使用肝素化注射器从尾动脉采集血液样本。
text_en: Before euthanizing the fish, blood samples were collected from the caudal artery using heparinized syringes after anesthesia with a 150 mg/L solution of 2-phenoxyethanol.
outcome: 采样操作与生理指标监测

quote: L17 represents diets containing of 17% lipid content, which was not benefit for hepatic lipid utilization and metabolism in the present study.
statement: L17代表含有17%脂质含量的日粮，在本研究中不利于肝脏脂质的利用和代谢。
text_zh: L17代表含有17%脂质含量的日粮，在本研究中不利于肝脏脂质的利用和代谢。
text_en: L17 represents a diet containing 17% lipid content, which was unfavorable for hepatic lipid utilization and metabolism in this study.

quote: Each feeding group consisted of 5 tanks (i.e., replicates), and 15 juveniles were stocked per tank.
statement: 每个饲喂组由5个水箱组成，每箱放养15尾幼鱼。
text_zh: 每个饲喂组由5个水箱组成，每箱放养15尾幼鱼。
text_en: Each feeding group consisted of 5 tanks, with 15 juveniles stocked per tank.

quote: Control group (C) was fed to apparent satiation twice daily (09:00 and 17:00) during the experimental periods, whereas the three remaining groups fasted for: 5 days (F5) from days 10–14 after initiation of the experiment; 10 days (F10) from days 5–14; 14 days (F14) from days 1–14 before satiation refeeding in week 3.
statement: 对照组每天两次饱食投喂，而其余三组分别禁食5天、10天和14天后恢复饱食投喂。
text_zh: 对照组每天两次饱食投喂，而其余三组分别禁食5天、10天和14天后恢复饱食投喂。
text_en: The control group was fed to satiation twice daily, while the other three groups were fasted for 5 days, 10 days, and 14 days respectively before resuming feeding to satiation.

quote: Daily feeding was performed by dropping pellet (the same as during the acclimation period) into each tank every few minutes until the fish ceased to eat due to satiation.
statement: 每日投喂采用颗粒饲料，每隔几分钟投入一次，直到鱼因饱腹而停止进食。
text_zh: 每日投喂采用颗粒饲料，每隔几分钟投入一次，直到鱼因饱腹而停止进食。
text_en: Pellet feed is administered daily, dropped in every few minutes until the fish stop eating due to satiety.

quote: Care was taken to ensure that all pellets provided were consumed by the fish.
statement: 采取措施确保提供的颗粒饲料全部被鱼食用。
text_zh: 采取措施确保提供的颗粒饲料全部被鱼食用。
text_en: Measures were taken to ensure that all of the provided pellet feed was consumed by the fish.

quote: The actual daily consumed feed amount was determined as the difference in weight between the feed supplied into the tank and the uneaten feed removed by siphon.
statement: 实际日摄食量通过投入饲料重量与虹吸移除的未食饲料重量之差来确定。
text_zh: 实际日摄食量通过投入饲料重量与虹吸移除的未食饲料重量之差来确定。
text_en: Actual daily feed intake was determined by the difference between the weight of feed added and the weight of uneaten feed removed by siphoning.
intervention: Feed intake assessment by quantity difference
intervention_record: 基于数量差的摄食量评估

quote: however, HSI values in F5, F10, and F14 were significantly higher than the control group (F = 0.059, df = 3, p = 0.016).
statement: 在实验结束时，F5、F10和F14组的肝体比（HSI）显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在实验结束时，F5、F10和F14组的肝体比（HSI）显著高于对照组。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, the hepatosomatic index (HSI) in groups F5, F10, and F14 was significantly higher than that in the control group.
intervention_record: 间歇禁食补偿生长策略

quote: The concentrations of TCHO (F = 7.727, df = 3, p = 0.01) in F14 were significantly lower than that in the control group after fasting (end of week 2), whereas concentrations of GLU in F14 were significantly higher than the control (F = 7.393, df = 3, p = 0.001).
statement: 在禁食后（第2周结束），F14组的总胆固醇（TCHO）浓度显著低于对照组，而葡萄糖（GLU）浓度显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在禁食后（第2周结束），F14组的总胆固醇（TCHO）浓度显著低于对照组，而葡萄糖（GLU）浓度显著高于对照组。
text_en: After fasting (at the end of week 2), the total cholesterol (TCHO) concentration in the F14 group was significantly lower than that in the control group, while the glucose (GLU) concentration was significantly higher than that in the control group.
intervention_record: 间歇禁食补偿生长策略

quote: The concentrations of Hb (F = 0.379, df = 3, p = 0.771), TCHO (F = 0.239, df = 3, p = 0.868), GOT (F = 2.132, df = 3, p = 0.149), GPT (F = 2.851, df = 3, p = 0.082), GLU (F = 0.028, df = 3, p = 0.993), and HDLC (F = 0.463, df = 3, p = 0.988) in the blood of juvenile S. scherzeri at the end of experimentation were not significantly different from the control group.
statement: 在实验结束时，幼鱼血液中的血红蛋白、总胆固醇、谷草转氨酶、谷丙转氨酶、葡萄糖和高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度与对照组无显著差异。
text_zh: 在实验结束时，幼鱼血液中的血红蛋白、总胆固醇、谷草转氨酶、谷丙转氨酶、葡萄糖和高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度与对照组无显著差异。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, there was no significant difference in the concentrations of hemoglobin, total cholesterol, aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, glucose, and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood of juvenile fish compared to the control group.
intervention_record: 间歇禁食补偿生长策略

quote: Compensation growth can be used as a feed supply strategy, whereby satiation feeding after feed deprivation can lead to faster growth and greater feed efficiency, translating into improved economic efficiency by reducing feed and labor costs
statement: 补偿生长可作为一种饲料供应策略，即在饲料剥夺后的饱食喂养可导致更快的生长和更高的饲料效率，从而通过减少饲料和劳动力成本提高经济效率。
text_zh: 补偿生长可作为一种饲料供应策略，即在饲料剥夺后的饱食喂养可导致更快的生长和更高的饲料效率，从而通过减少饲料和劳动力成本提高经济效率。
text_en: Compensatory growth can be used as a feed supply strategy, where ad libitum feeding after feed deprivation can lead to faster growth and higher feed efficiency, thereby improving economic efficiency by reducing feed and labor costs.

quote: During the experimental period, no mortality was observed in any of the experimental groups.
statement: 在实验期间，所有实验组均未观察到死亡率。
text_zh: 在实验期间，所有实验组均未观察到死亡率。
text_en: During the experimental period, no mortality was observed in any of the experimental groups.

quote: the body weights of F5, F10, and F14 immediately following the experimental fasting periods were all significantly lower than those of the control group (F = 53.919, df = 3, p 0.0001).
statement: 在实验性禁食期结束后，F5、F10和F14组的体重均显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在实验性禁食期结束后，F5、F10和F14组的体重均显著低于对照组。
text_en: After the experimental fasting period ended, the body weights of groups F5, F10, and F14 were all significantly lower than those of the control group.

quote: fish weights were significantly lower among F5, F10, and F14 following the first two weeks of feed resupply (week 4) compared with the control group (F = 14.358, df = 3, p 0.001).
statement: 在恢复投喂后的前两周（第4周），F5、F10和F14组的鱼体重仍显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在恢复投喂后的前两周（第4周），F5、F10和F14组的鱼体重仍显著低于对照组。
text_en: In the first two weeks after resuming feeding (week 4), the body weights of fish in the F5, F10 and F14 groups were still significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: Four weeks (week 6) and six weeks (week 8) after feed resupply, the weight of the fish did not differ significantly from that of the control group (week 6, F = 2.828, df = 3, p = 0.107; week 8, F = 1.75, df = 3, p = 0.234).
statement: 在恢复投喂四周（第6周）和六周（第8周）后，鱼的体重与对照组无显著差异。
text_zh: 在恢复投喂四周（第6周）和六周（第8周）后，鱼的体重与对照组无显著差异。
text_en: Four weeks (week 6) and six weeks (week 8) after resuming feeding, there was no significant difference in fish body weight compared to the control group.

quote: SGRs (F = 64.479, df = 3, p 0.001) of all the fasting groups during the first two weeks of feed resupply (weeks 3–4) were significantly greater than the control ( Figure 2 ).
statement: 在恢复投喂的前两周（第3-4周），所有禁食组的特定生长率（SGR）均显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在恢复投喂的前两周（第3-4周），所有禁食组的特定生长率（SGR）均显著高于对照组。
text_en: In the first two weeks of resumed feeding (weeks 3-4), the specific growth rate (SGR) of all fasted groups was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: During the second two weeks of feed resupply (weeks 5–6), F14 showed a significantly higher SGR than the control group (F = 9.655, df = 3, p 0.01), whereas no such difference was observed for F5 and F10.
statement: 在恢复投喂的第二个两周（第5-6周），F14组的特定生长率显著高于对照组，而F5和F10组未观察到这种差异。
text_zh: 在恢复投喂的第二个两周（第5-6周），F14组的特定生长率显著高于对照组，而F5和F10组未观察到这种差异。
text_en: In the second two-week period of refeeding (weeks 5-6), the specific growth rate of the F14 group was significantly higher than that of the control group, while no such difference was observed in the F5 and F10 groups.
intervention_record: 不同时长禁食后恢复投喂

quote: The overall FE during the six weeks of feed resupply (weeks 3–8) was only significantly higher for F14 compared to the control group (F = 8.139, df = 3, p = 0.008).
statement: 在为期六周的饲料恢复供应期间（第3-8周），只有F14组的总体摄食效率显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在为期六周的饲料恢复供应期间（第3-8周），只有F14组的总体摄食效率显著高于对照组。
text_en: During the six-week feed restoration period (weeks 3-8), only the F14 group had significantly higher overall feed efficiency than the control group.

quote: The fasting period did not affect the CF f (F = 0.06, df = 3, p = 0.98), CVBL f (F = 0.143, df = 3, p = 0.931) and CVBW f (F = 0.086, df = 3, p = 0.966).
statement: 禁食期未影响肥满度、体长变异系数和体重变异系数。
text_zh: 禁食期未影响肥满度、体长变异系数和体重变异系数。
text_en: The fasting period did not affect condition factor, coefficient of variation in body length, and coefficient of variation in body weight.

quote: Lipid (F = 37.407, df = 3, p = 0.002), HSI (F = 7.612, df = 3, p = 0.04), of F10 and F14 after fasting (week 2), as well as lipid/LBM (F = 36.028, df = 3, p = 0.002) and VSI (F = 14.549, df = 3, p = 0.013) of all fasting groups, were significantly lower than the control; however, moisture content (F = 12.493, df = 3, p = 0.017) in F14 was significantly higher than the control.
statement: 禁食后，F10和F14组的脂质和肝体比显著低于对照组；所有禁食组的脂质/去脂体重和内脏体比也显著低于对照组；但F14组的水分含量显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 禁食后，F10和F14组的脂质和肝体比显著低于对照组；所有禁食组的脂质/去脂体重和内脏体比也显著低于对照组；但F14组的水分含量显著高于对照组。
text_en: After fasting, the lipid and hepatosomatic indices of groups F10 and F14 were significantly lower than those of the control group; the lipid/lean body weight and viscerosomatic indices of all fasting groups were also significantly lower than those of the control group; however, the moisture content of group F14 was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: Therefore, during the initial resupply of food in the present study, the FE of the fasting group was very high; however, with time, the FE decreased or was not significantly different from the control group.
statement: 因此，在本研究的初始重新投喂期间，禁食组的饲料效率非常高；然而，随着时间的推移，饲料效率下降或与对照组无显著差异。
text_zh: 因此，在本研究的初始重新投喂期间，禁食组的饲料效率非常高；然而，随着时间的推移，饲料效率下降或与对照组无显著差异。
text_en: Therefore, during the initial refeeding period in this study, feed efficiency was very high in the fasted group; however, over time, feed efficiency decreased or showed no significant difference compared to the control group.
counterevidence: 后期饲料效率优势消失或下降

quote: Similarly, improved FE during feed resupply was documented for European minnow ( Phoxinus phoxinus ) [ 48 ], gibel carp [ 49 ], Chinese longsnout catfish [ 40 ], Atlantic halibut (Hippoglossus hippoglossus ) [ 50 ], blackhead seabream ( Acanthopagrus schlegelii ) [ 14 ], and rock bream [ 5 ].
statement: 文献记载了多种鱼类在重新投喂期间摄食效率有所提高。
text_zh: 文献记载了多种鱼类在重新投喂期间摄食效率有所提高。
text_en: Literature records that feeding efficiency improved in various fish species during refeeding.

population.species: 欧洲鲦鱼、鲫鱼、中华长吻鮠、大西洋庸鲽、黑头鲷、岩鲷

quote: Throughout the present study, hyperphagia and improved FE tended to decrease with time, both of which were attributed to the two factors acting as major determinants of compensatory growth of S. scherzeri , as this tendency was seen in all fasting groups, and similar results have been observed in other previous studies as well [ 3 , 5 , 34 ].
statement: 本研究中，暴食和摄食效率的提高随时间呈下降趋势，这两者被认为是S. scherzeri补偿生长的主要决定因素。
text_zh: 本研究中，暴食和摄食效率的提高随时间呈下降趋势，这两者被认为是S. scherzeri补偿生长的主要决定因素。
text_en: In this study, hyperphagia and improved feeding efficiency showed a declining trend over time; these two factors are considered the main determinants of compensatory growth in S. scherzeri.

quote: It has been reported, however, that compensatory growth occurs primarily due to the increase in FR and not from improvements in FE during feed resupply after fasting [ 8 , 41 , 45 , 51 , 52 , 53 ], suggesting that the major factors driving compensatory growth differ.
statement: 有报告指出，补偿生长主要源于采食率（FR）的增加，而非禁食后重新投喂期间摄食效率（FE）的改善，这表明驱动补偿生长的主要因素存在差异。
text_zh: 有报告指出，补偿生长主要源于采食率（FR）的增加，而非禁食后重新投喂期间摄食效率（FE）的改善，这表明驱动补偿生长的主要因素存在差异。
text_en: Reports indicate that compensatory growth is primarily due to an increase in feed intake rate (FR), rather than an improvement in feed efficiency (FE) during refeeding after fasting, suggesting that the main factors driving compensatory growth differ.

quote: In the experiment here, the CF, CVBW, and CVBL of juvenile S. scherzeri were not affected by compensatory growth.
statement: 在本实验中，幼鱼S. scherzeri的条件因子（CF）、体重变异系数（CVBW）和体长变异系数（CVBL）未受补偿生长影响。
text_zh: 在本实验中，幼鱼S. scherzeri的条件因子（CF）、体重变异系数（CVBW）和体长变异系数（CVBL）未受补偿生长影响。
text_en: In this experiment, the condition factor (CF), coefficient of variation of body weight (CVBW), and coefficient of variation of body length (CVBL) of juvenile S. scherzeri were not affected by compensatory growth.

quote: Fasting groups in this study experienced a rise in moisture content after feed deprivation, and similar to previous studies, lipid content and HSI decreased [ 42 , 43 , 54 , 55 ].
statement: 本研究中的禁食组在停止投喂后水分含量上升，且脂质含量和肝体比（HSI）下降。
text_zh: 本研究中的禁食组在停止投喂后水分含量上升，且脂质含量和肝体比（HSI）下降。
text_en: In this study, the fasting group showed an increase in moisture content and a decrease in lipid content and hepatosomatic index (HSI) after feeding was stopped.

quote: The present experiment determined that all juvenile S. scherzeri (initial mean weight, 14.7 g) subjected to 5–14 days of food deprivation experienced full compensatory growth after four weeks of food resupply under our experimental conditions.
statement: 本实验确定，所有初始平均体重为14.7克的S. scherzeri幼鱼在经历5至14天的食物剥夺后，在重新喂食四周后实现了完全的补偿性生长。
text_zh: 本实验确定，所有初始平均体重为14.7克的S. scherzeri幼鱼在经历5至14天的食物剥夺后，在重新喂食四周后实现了完全的补偿性生长。
text_en: This experiment determined that all S. scherzeri juveniles with an initial average body weight of 14.7 g achieved full compensatory growth four weeks after refeeding, following a food deprivation period of 5 to 14 days.

quote: Responding well to the feeding strategy of fasting and resupplying, S. scherzeri maintained similar body compositions, blood, morphological, and biochemical characteristics compared to the continuously fed control group within 6 weeks after resupply commenced.
statement: 对禁食和再投喂的饲养策略反应良好，S. scherzeri在恢复投喂开始后的6周内保持了与持续投喂对照组相似的身体成分、血液、形态学和生化特征。
text_zh: 对禁食和再投喂的饲养策略反应良好，S. scherzeri在恢复投喂开始后的6周内保持了与持续投喂对照组相似的身体成分、血液、形态学和生化特征。
text_en: Responded well to fasting and refeeding feeding strategies, S. scherzeri maintained body composition, blood, morphological and biochemical characteristics similar to the continuous feeding control group within 6 weeks after the start of resumed feeding.

quote: f the body weight of fish subjected to fasting as compared to those fish in the control group has been previously discussed as a critical indicator of full compensatory growth
statement: 与对照组相比，禁食鱼类的体重变化被认为是完全补偿生长的关键指标。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，禁食鱼类的体重变化被认为是完全补偿生长的关键指标。
text_en: Compared to the control group, weight change in fasted fish is considered a key indicator of full compensatory growth.

quote: Tian and Qin [ 43 ] determined that after fasting, full compensatory growth occurred for ≥60% of fish body weight in the control group
statement: Tian和Qin确定，在禁食后，当体重达到对照组的≥60%时发生完全补偿生长。
text_zh: Tian和Qin确定，在禁食后，当体重达到对照组的≥60%时发生完全补偿生长。
text_en: Tian and Qin determined that complete compensatory growth occurred after fasting when body weight reached ≥60% of the control group.

quote: During the present experiment, F5, F10, and F14 all showed full compensatory growth after fasting for 5 to 14 days for individuals with body weights of ≥~60% (61.7–81.1%) than the control group.
statement: 在本实验中，F5、F10和F14组在禁食5至14天后，对于体重达到对照组约60%（61.7–81.1%）以上的个体均表现出完全补偿生长。
text_zh: 在本实验中，F5、F10和F14组在禁食5至14天后，对于体重达到对照组约60%（61.7–81.1%）以上的个体均表现出完全补偿生长。
text_en: In this experiment, the F5, F10 and F14 groups showed complete compensatory growth in individuals whose body weight reached about 60% (61.7–81.1%) or more of the control group after fasting for 5 to 14 days.

quote: The SGR and FR values after fasting increased during the early feed resupply stages (weeks 3–4) with an increasing duration of food deprivation
statement: 随着食物剥夺时间的增加，禁食后的特定生长率（SGR）和摄食率（FR）值在早期重新投喂阶段（第3-4周）增加。
text_zh: 随着食物剥夺时间的增加，禁食后的特定生长率（SGR）和摄食率（FR）值在早期重新投喂阶段（第3-4周）增加。
text_en: As the duration of food deprivation increased, specific growth rate (SGR) and feeding rate (FR) values increased during the early refeeding phase (weeks 3-4).

quote: whereas similar values to the control group were observed during the latter food resupply (weeks 7–8)
statement: 而在后期重新投喂阶段（第7-8周），观察到与对照组相似的数值。
text_zh: 而在后期重新投喂阶段（第7-8周），观察到与对照组相似的数值。
text_en: In the later re-feeding stage (weeks 7-8), values similar to those of the control group were observed.

quote: Generally, these phenomena occur during the initial resupply of feed immediately following the period of deprivation due to a hyperphagic response
statement: 通常，这些现象发生在剥夺期后立即重新投喂饲料的初期，这是由于贪食反应所致。
text_zh: 通常，这些现象发生在剥夺期后立即重新投喂饲料的初期，这是由于贪食反应所致。
text_en: Usually, these phenomena occur in the initial period immediately after refeeding following a deprivation period, due to hyperphagia.

quote: inducing compensatory growth that decreases with time [ 5 , 42 ] as well as a decrease in the digestibility of excess feed intake
statement: 诱导随时间推移而减弱的补偿生长，以及过量摄入饲料消化率的降低。
text_zh: 诱导随时间推移而减弱的补偿生长，以及过量摄入饲料消化率的降低。
text_en: Compensatory growth that diminishes over time, and a decrease in the digestibility of excess feed intake.
counterevidence: 过量摄入导致消化率降低

quote: Depending on the strength of fish body weight recovery following fasting, the degree of compensatory growth is classified as over, complete (i.e., full), partial, and non-compensatory
statement: 根据禁食后鱼体重恢复的强度，补偿生长的程度被分为过度、完全（即充分）、部分和非补偿性。
text_zh: 根据禁食后鱼体重恢复的强度，补偿生长的程度被分为过度、完全（即充分）、部分和非补偿性。
text_en: Based on the intensity of fish body weight recovery after fasting, the degree of compensatory growth is classified as over-, complete (i.e., adequate), partial, and non-compensatory.

quote: Notably, the degree of compensatory growth is sensitive to both the degree and duration of fasting prior to satiation feeding
statement: 值得注意的是，补偿生长的程度对饱食投喂前禁食的程度和持续时间都很敏感。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，补偿生长的程度对饱食投喂前禁食的程度和持续时间都很敏感。
text_en: It is worth noting that the extent of compensatory growth is sensitive to both the degree and duration of fasting prior to satiation feeding.

quote: Here, all juvenile S. scherzeri subjected to five- (F5), 10- (F10), and 14-day (F14) fasting showed full compensatory growth that caught up with the weight of the control group four weeks after feed resupply.
statement: 本研究中，所有经历5天（F5）、10天（F10）和14天（F14）禁食的幼体S. scherzeri均表现出完全的补偿生长，在重新投喂四周后体重追上了对照组。
text_zh: 本研究中，所有经历5天（F5）、10天（F10）和14天（F14）禁食的幼体S. scherzeri均表现出完全的补偿生长，在重新投喂四周后体重追上了对照组。
text_en: In this study, all juvenile S. scherzeri that underwent fasting for 5 days (F5), 10 days (F10), and 14 days (F14) exhibited complete compensatory growth, catching up to the control group in body weight after four weeks of refeeding.

quote: Similarly, full compensatory growth after ≤2 weeks of fasting was reported to be observed in rock bream ( Oplegnathus fasciatus ) [ 5 ], Chinese longsnout catfish ( Leiocassis longirostris ) [ 39 ], gibel carp ( Carassius auratus gibelio ) [ 41 ], and gilthead seabream ( Sparus auratus ) [ 42 ].
statement: 同样，据报道在≤2周的禁食后，石鲷、中国长吻鮠、异育银鲫和金头鲷也观察到了完全的补偿生长。
text_zh: 同样，据报道在≤2周的禁食后，石鲷、中国长吻鮠、异育银鲫和金头鲷也观察到了完全的补偿生长。
text_en: Similarly, complete compensatory growth has also been reported in Oplegnathus fasciatus, Leiocassis longirostris, Carassius auratus gibelio, and Sparus aurata after fasting of ≤2 weeks.

population.species: Oplegnathus fasciatus; Leiocassis longirostris; Carassius auratus gibelio; Sparus auratus

quote: However, economic losses caused by diseases in these fishes are becoming a serious challenge.
statement: 疾病导致的经济损失正成为这些鱼类养殖的一个严重挑战。
text_zh: 疾病导致的经济损失正成为这些鱼类养殖的一个严重挑战。
text_en: Economic losses caused by disease are becoming a serious challenge for the farming of these fish.

population.species: 鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi) 和大口黑鲈 (Micropterus salmoides)

quote: One of the important viral pathogens in the aquaculture of the two fishes is the ranavirus, which has been isolated from the two fishes in recent years [ 20 , 21 , 22 ].
statement: 蛙病毒是这两种鱼类养殖中重要的病毒性病原体之一，近年来已从这两种鱼中分离出来。
text_zh: 蛙病毒是这两种鱼类养殖中重要的病毒性病原体之一，近年来已从这两种鱼中分离出来。
text_en: Ranavirus is one of the important viral pathogens in the farming of these two fish species, and has been isolated from both species in recent years.

population.species: 鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi) 和大口黑鲈 (Micropterus salmoides)

quote: The present experiment found that the lipid/LBM of the F5, F10, and F14 groups were significantly lower than that of the control group following fasting (end of week 2), and no differences in SGR and lipid/LBM were observed between the fasting and control groups at the end of the experiment (end of week 8), thus indicating the efficacy of the lipostatic model.
statement: 本实验发现，禁食组（F5、F10和F14）在禁食后（第2周末）的脂质/去脂体重显著低于对照组，但在实验结束时（第8周末），禁食组与对照组之间的特定生长率和脂质/去脂体重无差异，这表明了脂肪稳态模型的有效性。
text_zh: 本实验发现，禁食组（F5、F10和F14）在禁食后（第2周末）的脂质/去脂体重显著低于对照组，但在实验结束时（第8周末），禁食组与对照组之间的特定生长率和脂质/去脂体重无差异，这表明了脂肪稳态模型的有效性。
text_en: This experiment found that the fasting groups (F5, F10, and F14) had significantly lower lipid/fat-free body weight after fasting (end of week 2) compared to the control group, but at the end of the experiment (end of week 8), there was no difference in specific growth rate or lipid/fat-free body weight between the fasting groups and the control group, indicating the validity of the fat homeostasis model.

quote: Based on the results of the experiment here, the HSI after fasting significantly decreased compared to the control group as the duration of fasting increased.
statement: 根据本实验结果，随着禁食时间的增加，禁食后的肝体比（HSI）与对照组相比显著下降。
text_zh: 根据本实验结果，随着禁食时间的增加，禁食后的肝体比（HSI）与对照组相比显著下降。
text_en: According to the results of this experiment, as the fasting duration increased, the hepatosomatic index (HSI) after fasting decreased significantly compared with the control group.

quote: Silva et al. [ 17 ] reared pacamã ( Lophiosilurus alexandri ) for a total of 45 days with a 6:1 and 5:2 feed to fasting regime, and their results showed that the HSI was the lowest in the 5:2 group, which is similar the results found in the present study.
statement: Silva等人[17]对pacamã鱼进行了总共45天的饲养，采用6:1和5:2的投喂与禁食比例，结果显示5:2组的肝体比最低，这与本研究发现的结果相似。
text_zh: Silva等人[17]对pacamã鱼进行了总共45天的饲养，采用6:1和5:2的投喂与禁食比例，结果显示5:2组的肝体比最低，这与本研究发现的结果相似。
text_en: Silva et al. [17] reared pacamã fish for a total of 45 days using feeding-to-fasting ratios of 6:1 and 5:2, showing that the hepatosomatic index was lowest in the 5:2 group, which is similar to the results found in this study.

quote: As demonstrated in the present study, the lower HSI values with longer fasting periods indicated the need for greater hepatic energy storage, and Morshedi et al. [ 15 ] reported that fasting decreased the amount of hepatic energy available, directly affecting liver weight.
statement: 如本研究所示，较长的禁食期导致较低的肝体比值，表明需要更多的肝脏能量储存；Morshedi等人[15]报道禁食减少了可用的肝脏能量，直接影响肝脏重量。
text_zh: 如本研究所示，较长的禁食期导致较低的肝体比值，表明需要更多的肝脏能量储存；Morshedi等人[15]报道禁食减少了可用的肝脏能量，直接影响肝脏重量。
text_en: As shown in this study, longer fasting periods led to lower hepatosomatic indices, indicating a need for more hepatic energy storage; Morshedi et al. [15] reported that fasting reduced available liver energy, directly affecting liver weight.

quote: SGRs during the final two weeks (weeks 7–8) were not significantly different between the experimental groups (F = 1.148.3, df = 3, p = 0.3871)
statement: 在最后两周（第7-8周）期间，各实验组之间的特定生长率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在最后两周（第7-8周）期间，各实验组之间的特定生长率没有显著差异。
text_en: During the last two weeks (weeks 7-8), there was no significant difference in specific growth rate among the experimental groups.

quote: however, the overall SGR over the six weeks of feed resupply (weeks 3–8) was significantly higher in the fasting groups (F = 44.21, df = 3, p 0.001), with F14 exhibiting the highest SGR.
statement: 然而，在六周的饲料补充期（第3-8周）内，禁食组的总体特定生长率显著较高，其中F14表现出最高的特定生长率。
text_zh: 然而，在六周的饲料补充期（第3-8周）内，禁食组的总体特定生长率显著较高，其中F14表现出最高的特定生长率。
text_en: However, during the six-week feed supplementation period (weeks 3-8), the fasted group had a significantly higher overall specific growth rate, with F14 showing the highest specific growth rate.

quote: During the first two weeks of feed resupply (weeks 3–4), FRs in all fasting groups were significantly higher than in the control group (F = 33.865, df = 3, p 0.001; Figure 3 ).
statement: 在饲料补充的前两周（第3-4周），所有禁食组的摄食率均显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在饲料补充的前两周（第3-4周），所有禁食组的摄食率均显著高于对照组。
text_en: In the first two weeks of feed supplementation (weeks 3-4), the feeding rates of all fasting groups were significantly higher than those of the control group.

quote: During the second two weeks of feed resupply (weeks 5–6), F14 showed significantly higher FR than the control group, while F5 and F10 did not differ from the control group (F = 7.707, df = 3, p = 0.01).
statement: 在饲料补充的第二两周（第5-6周），F14的摄食率显著高于对照组，而F5和F10与对照组无差异。
text_zh: 在饲料补充的第二两周（第5-6周），F14的摄食率显著高于对照组，而F5和F10与对照组无差异。
text_en: In the second and third weeks of feed replenishment (weeks 5-6), the feeding rate of F14 was significantly higher than that of the control group, while there was no significant difference between F5 and F10 compared to the control group.

quote: The FR during the final two weeks of resupply (weeks 7 to 8) was not significantly different between the experimental groups (F = 1.034, df = 3, p = 0.428).
statement: 在补充期的最后两周（第7至8周），各实验组之间的摄食率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在补充期的最后两周（第7至8周），各实验组之间的摄食率没有显著差异。
text_en: During the last two weeks of the refeeding period (weeks 7 to 8), there was no significant difference in feed intake among the experimental groups.

quote: The overall FR during the six weeks following the fasting period (weeks 3–8) showed the highest FR in F14, followed by F10, F5, and the control group (F = 20.103, df = 3, p 0.001).
statement: 在禁食期后的六周（第3-8周）内，总体摄食率在F14中最高，其次是F10、F5和对照组。
text_zh: 在禁食期后的六周（第3-8周）内，总体摄食率在F14中最高，其次是F10、F5和对照组。
text_en: During the six weeks following the fasting period (weeks 3-8), the overall feeding rate was highest in F14, followed by F10, F5 and the control group.

quote: In most animals, the lipid stores indicate the easily activated energy reserves, and the lean body mass (LBM) includes the structural tissues, so the lipid/LBM may be considered an indicator of nutritional state
statement: 在大多数动物中，脂质储存代表易激活的能量储备，而瘦体重包含结构组织，因此脂质/LBM比值可被视为营养状态的指标。
text_zh: 在大多数动物中，脂质储存代表易激活的能量储备，而瘦体重包含结构组织，因此脂质/LBM比值可被视为营养状态的指标。
text_en: In most animals, lipid storage represents readily mobilizable energy reserves, while lean body mass contains structural tissues; therefore, the lipid/LBM ratio can be considered an indicator of nutritional status.

quote: The lipostatic model hypothesized that restricted feeding induces changes in adiposity through compensatory feeding as a result of negative feedback due to changes in energy balance
statement: 脂质稳态模型假设，限制饲喂通过能量平衡变化引起的负反馈导致脂肪量改变，进而引发补偿性摄食。
text_zh: 脂质稳态模型假设，限制饲喂通过能量平衡变化引起的负反馈导致脂肪量改变，进而引发补偿性摄食。
text_en: The lipid homeostasis model hypothesizes that restricted feeding leads to changes in fat mass through negative feedback caused by changes in energy balance, which in turn triggers compensatory feeding.

quote: Therefore, fat loss after restricted feeding reduces the negative feedback on feed intake and elevated feed intake until normal fat levels and lipid/LBM are maintained.
statement: 因此，限制饲喂后的脂肪流失减少了对摄食的负反馈，并提高摄食量直至维持正常的脂肪水平和脂质/LBM比值。
text_zh: 因此，限制饲喂后的脂肪流失减少了对摄食的负反馈，并提高摄食量直至维持正常的脂肪水平和脂质/LBM比值。
text_en: Therefore, reduced fat loss after restricted feeding decreased the negative feedback on feed intake and increased feed intake until normal fat levels and lipid/LBM ratios were maintained.

quote: In other words, the lipostatic model represents that the size of body lipid reserves affects the feed intake (i.e., hyperphagic response) of fish via the negative feedback signal to the central nervous system, thereby regulating the feed intake behavior, body weight, and body composition during compensatory growth.
statement: 换句话说，脂质稳态模型表明，体内脂质储备的大小通过向中枢神经系统发送负反馈信号影响鱼类的摄食（即暴食反应），从而在补偿性生长期间调节摄食行为、体重和身体组成。
text_zh: 换句话说，脂质稳态模型表明，体内脂质储备的大小通过向中枢神经系统发送负反馈信号影响鱼类的摄食（即暴食反应），从而在补偿性生长期间调节摄食行为、体重和身体组成。
text_en: In other words, the lipid homeostasis model suggests that the size of body lipid reserves influences fish feeding (i.e., compensatory hyperphagia) by sending negative feedback signals to the central nervous system, thereby regulating feeding behavior, body weight, and body composition during compensatory growth.

quote: Therefore, if the body lipid reserves of fish are repleted very slowly, the compensatory growth through the hyperphagic response can be sustained because the imbalance of the lipid/LBM is maintained for a long time
statement: 因此，如果鱼类的体内脂质储备补充非常缓慢，通过暴食反应的补偿性生长可以持续，因为脂质/LBM的不平衡会长时间保持。
text_zh: 因此，如果鱼类的体内脂质储备补充非常缓慢，通过暴食反应的补偿性生长可以持续，因为脂质/LBM的不平衡会长时间保持。
text_en: Therefore, if the replenishment of lipid reserves in fish is very slow, compensatory growth through hyperphagia can persist because the lipid/LBM imbalance will be maintained for a long time.

quote: It is very important to extend the period of imbalance of the lipid/LBM by controlling the repletion of body lipid storage during refeeding after restricted feeding or fasting, and further study is needed in the future.
statement: 通过在限制饲喂或禁食后的复饲期间控制体内脂质储存的补充来延长脂质/LBM不平衡期非常重要，未来需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 通过在限制饲喂或禁食后的复饲期间控制体内脂质储存的补充来延长脂质/LBM不平衡期非常重要，未来需要进一步研究。
text_en: It is important to extend the lipid/LBM imbalance period by controlling the replenishment of body lipid stores during refeeding after restricted feeding or fasting, and further research is needed in the future.

quote: During the present study, it was observed that fasting influenced GLU and TCHO levels in the plasma of juvenile S. scherzeri
statement: 本研究发现禁食影响了幼鱼S. scherzeri血浆中的葡萄糖和总胆固醇水平。
text_zh: 本研究发现禁食影响了幼鱼S. scherzeri血浆中的葡萄糖和总胆固醇水平。
text_en: This study found that fasting affected plasma glucose and total cholesterol levels in juvenile S. scherzeri.

quote: however, no such increase in plasma GLU was observed in sea bass ( Dicentraachus labrax ) [ 71 ] or pirapitinga ( Piaractus brachypomus ) [ 72 ].
statement: 然而，在海鲈和Piaractus brachypomus中未观察到血浆葡萄糖的这种增加。
text_zh: 然而，在海鲈和Piaractus brachypomus中未观察到血浆葡萄糖的这种增加。
text_en: However, this increase in plasma glucose was not observed in sea bass and Piaractus brachypomus.

quote: Cholesterol is a structural lipid utilized or synthesized in response to feed deprivation; however, it is also maintained during feed deprivation without increasing, decreasing, or changing depending on the species and fasting duration [ 72 ].
statement: 胆固醇是一种在饲料剥夺期间被利用或合成的结构脂质；然而，根据物种和禁食时长的不同，它在禁食期间也可能保持不变而不增加、减少或改变。
text_zh: 胆固醇是一种在饲料剥夺期间被利用或合成的结构脂质；然而，根据物种和禁食时长的不同，它在禁食期间也可能保持不变而不增加、减少或改变。
text_en: Cholesterol is a structural lipid that is utilized or synthesized during feed deprivation; however, depending on the species and duration of fasting, it may also remain unchanged without increasing, decreasing, or changing during fasting.

quote: For the present study, the cholesterol concentrations decreased after fasting (week 2), similar to the results observed for rainbow trout [ 73 ], brown trout ( Salmo trutta ) [ 74 ] and sturgeon ( Acipenser naccarii ) [ 75 ].
statement: 在本研究中，禁食后（第2周）胆固醇浓度降低，这与虹鳟、褐鳟和鲟鱼观察到的结果相似。
text_zh: 在本研究中，禁食后（第2周）胆固醇浓度降低，这与虹鳟、褐鳟和鲟鱼观察到的结果相似。
text_en: In this study, cholesterol concentrations decreased after fasting (week 2), which is similar to results observed in rainbow trout, brown trout and sturgeon.

quote: Additionally, a decrease in feed intake of S. scherzeri due to either a decrease in feeding frequency or feeding ratio was also associated with a decrease in plasma TCHO concentrations [ 26 , 31 , 32 ].
statement: 此外，由于喂食频率或喂食比例降低导致的S. scherzeri摄食量减少也与血浆总胆固醇浓度的降低有关。
text_zh: 此外，由于喂食频率或喂食比例降低导致的S. scherzeri摄食量减少也与血浆总胆固醇浓度的降低有关。
text_en: In addition, the reduction in feed intake of S. scherzeri due to decreased feeding frequency or feeding ratio was also associated with a decrease in plasma total cholesterol concentration.

quote: In contrast, no change in TCHO concentrations was documented for pirapitinga [ 72 ], tamaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) [ 6 ], and pacamã [ 17 ], whereas an increase was observed with pacu ( Piaractus mesopotamicus ) [ 76 ] and climbing perch ( Anabas testudineus ) [ 77 ], similarly suggesting variable results according to species and fasting regime.
statement: 相比之下，Pirapitinga、Tamaqui和pacamã的总胆固醇浓度没有变化，而Pacu和攀鲈则观察到增加，这同样表明结果因物种和禁食方案而异。
text_zh: 相比之下，Pirapitinga、Tamaqui和pacamã的总胆固醇浓度没有变化，而Pacu和攀鲈则观察到增加，这同样表明结果因物种和禁食方案而异。
text_en: In contrast, total cholesterol concentrations did not change in Pirapitinga, Tamaqui and pacamã, while an increase was observed in Pacu and climbing perch, which also indicates that results vary by species and fasting protocol.

population.species: Piaractus brachypomus; Colossoma macropomum; Lophiosilurus alexandri; Piaractus mesopotamicus; Anabas testudineus

text_en: The experiment assessed health impacts by adding SCRV virus to petri dishes containing zebrafish larvae for infection and counting their deaths.

quote: 随着养殖规模的扩大以及对高养殖效益的追求, 人们过往疏忽了对鳜人工繁殖选育的科学管理, 这导致鳜的抗病性下降, 严重影响育种效益、质量和安全
statement: 对鳜人工繁殖选育科学管理的疏忽导致其抗病性下降，进而影响育种效益、质量和安全。
text_zh: 对鳜人工繁殖选育科学管理的疏忽导致其抗病性下降，进而影响育种效益、质量和安全。
text_en: Neglect of scientific management in artificial breeding and selection of mandarin fish has led to a decline in its disease resistance, thereby affecting the benefits, quality, and safety of breeding.

quote: 发现鳜SMYD3显著增强了SCRV病毒的复制(图 2E—2G)。

text_en: Under infection conditions, Siniperca chuatsi SMYD3 significantly enhanced SCRV virus replication.

quote: At the end of the experiment, the higher HSI in the fasting groups compared to the control was due to an excess accumulation of energy during the recovery process associated with feed resupply.
statement: 实验结束时，与对照组相比，禁食组较高的肝体指数（HSI）是由于在饲料重新供给相关的恢复过程中能量过度积累所致。
text_zh: 实验结束时，与对照组相比，禁食组较高的肝体指数（HSI）是由于在饲料重新供给相关的恢复过程中能量过度积累所致。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, the higher hepatosomatic index (HSI) in the fasting group compared to the control group was due to excessive energy accumulation during the recovery process associated with feed re-supply.

quote: Fish can reduce their energy requirements by reducing the mass of gastrointestinal tissues during a fasting period [ 63 ], which is consistent with the findings of the VSI reduction observed after fasting in the present study.
statement: 鱼类可以通过在禁食期间减少胃肠道组织的质量来降低其能量需求，这与本研究中观察到的禁食后内脏体指数（VSI）降低的结果一致。
text_zh: 鱼类可以通过在禁食期间减少胃肠道组织的质量来降低其能量需求，这与本研究中观察到的禁食后内脏体指数（VSI）降低的结果一致。
text_en: Fish can reduce their energy requirements by decreasing the mass of gastrointestinal tissues during fasting, which is consistent with the observed reduction in viscerosomatic index (VSI) after fasting in this study.
outcome: 胃肠道组织质量与能量需求

quote: According to Jobling [ 64 ], fasting increases the digestive tract capacity of fish, allowing them to consume more due to the hyperphagia that may occur throughout the recovery period.
statement: 根据Jobling的说法，禁食增加了鱼类的消化道容量，使其能够因恢复期间可能发生的暴食行为而摄入更多食物。
text_zh: 根据Jobling的说法，禁食增加了鱼类的消化道容量，使其能够因恢复期间可能发生的暴食行为而摄入更多食物。
text_en: According to Jobling, fasting increased the gastrointestinal capacity of fish, enabling them to consume more food due to compensatory hyperphagia that may occur during recovery.
outcome: 消化道容量与摄食行为

quote: This would partially explain the increase in VSI of the fasting group seen at the end of the present experiment and correlate with the hyperphagic behavior observed here as well.
statement: 这可以部分解释本实验结束时观察到的禁食组VSI的增加，并与此处观察到的暴食行为相关联。
text_zh: 这可以部分解释本实验结束时观察到的禁食组VSI的增加，并与此处观察到的暴食行为相关联。
text_en: This may partially explain the increase in VSI observed in the fasted group at the end of this experiment, and is associated with the binge eating behavior observed here.
outcome: 内脏体指数与摄食行为

quote: A hematological and biochemical assessment of fish has been used to determine their physiological status [ 15 ], and it was revealed that these factors could be affected by biotic and abiotic factors, such as age, sex, water temperature, seasonal patterns, and food intake [ 65 ].
statement: 血液学和生化评估已被用于确定鱼类的生理状态，结果显示这些因素可能受到年龄、性别、水温、季节模式和食物摄入量等生物和非生物因素的影响。
text_zh: 血液学和生化评估已被用于确定鱼类的生理状态，结果显示这些因素可能受到年龄、性别、水温、季节模式和食物摄入量等生物和非生物因素的影响。
text_en: Hematological and biochemical assessments have been used to determine the physiological status of fish, with results showing that these factors may be influenced by biotic and abiotic factors such as age, sex, water temperature, seasonal patterns, and food intake.
outcome: 生理状态指标的影响因素

quote: The CPE in SCSC cells seemed more serious than in the other two cells.
statement: SCSC细胞中的细胞病变效应似乎比其他两种细胞更严重。
text_zh: SCSC细胞中的细胞病变效应似乎比其他两种细胞更严重。
text_en: The cytopathic effect in SCSC cells appeared more severe than in the other two cell types.
