text_zh: SCRV感染导致鳜出现多器官点状出血症状，且致死率极高。
text_en: SCRV infection causes multifocal hemorrhage in multiple organs of mandarin fish, with a very high mortality rate.

quote: To investigate expression stability of the miRNAs during fasting and refeeding experiments, 80 Chinese perch juveniles (average body weight 150 g, 90 dph) in a net cage (5 m × 5 m × 2 m) were reared under the same conditions as described above and they were fed with mud carp (average body weight 10 g) for one week.
statement: 为了研究禁食和再喂食期间miRNA的表达稳定性，将80条鳜鱼幼鱼在网箱中饲养一周并投喂泥鳅。
text_zh: 为了研究禁食和再喂食期间miRNA的表达稳定性，将80条鳜鱼幼鱼在网箱中饲养一周并投喂泥鳅。
text_en: To study the stability of miRNA expression during fasting and refeeding, 80 juvenile mandarin fish were raised in cages for one week and fed loach.

quote: All the C t variation ranges of these miRNAs during fasting-refeeding treatment were smaller than those in different tissues and different developmental stages.
statement: 在禁食-再喂食处理期间，这些miRNA的Ct值变化范围小于不同组织和不同发育阶段的变化范围。
text_zh: 在禁食-再喂食处理期间，这些miRNA的Ct值变化范围小于不同组织和不同发育阶段的变化范围。
text_en: During the fasting-refeeding treatment, the range of Ct value changes for these miRNAs was smaller than the ranges observed across different tissues and developmental stages.
outcome: 营养胁迫下的分子稳定性

quote: The pivotal role of amino acids to regulate food intake and energy homeostasis has been recently elucidated [ 2 , 4 , 26 ], which strongly accounts for a unique ability of essential amino acids.
statement: 氨基酸在调节摄食量和能量稳态中的关键作用已被阐明，这主要归因于必需氨基酸的独特能力。
text_zh: 氨基酸在调节摄食量和能量稳态中的关键作用已被阐明，这主要归因于必需氨基酸的独特能力。
text_en: The key role of amino acids in regulating food intake and energy homeostasis has been elucidated, mainly attributed to the unique ability of essential amino acids.

quote: Lysine increased the food intake at 4 and 8 h, and methionine increased at 24 h, whereas tryptophan decreased at 1 h, as compared to the vehicle injection ( p 0.05) ( Figure 1 A).
statement: 脑室内注射赖氨酸在4和8小时增加了鳜鱼的摄食量，蛋氨酸在24小时增加了摄食量，而色氨酸在1小时减少了摄食量。
text_zh: 脑室内注射赖氨酸在4和8小时增加了鳜鱼的摄食量，蛋氨酸在24小时增加了摄食量，而色氨酸在1小时减少了摄食量。
text_en: Intracerebroventricular injection of lysine increased feed intake in mandarin fish at 4 and 8 hours, methionine increased feed intake at 24 hours, while tryptophan decreased feed intake at 1 hour.

quote: This study could establish a link between the systematic amino acid sensing and food intake control by amino acids and provide a theoretical basis for the study of feeding regulation networks, which has a profound significance for realizing low-fishmeal feeding for mandarin fish and other carnivorous fish.
statement: 该研究建立了系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸对摄食控制之间的联系，为低鱼粉饲料养殖提供理论基础。
text_zh: 该研究建立了系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸对摄食控制之间的联系，为低鱼粉饲料养殖提供理论基础。
text_en: This study established a link between systemic amino acid sensing and the control of feeding by amino acids, providing a theoretical basis for farming with low-fish-meal diets.

population.species: 鳜鱼及其他肉食性鱼类

quote: A considerable amount of literature provides evidence on a direct link between the mRNA level of hypothalamic neuropeptides and feeding behavior in rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ) [ 18 , 19 , 20 ].
statement: 文献证据表明，虹鳟下丘脑神经肽的mRNA水平与摄食行为之间存在直接联系。
text_zh: 文献证据表明，虹鳟下丘脑神经肽的mRNA水平与摄食行为之间存在直接联系。
text_en: Literature evidence indicates a direct link between mRNA levels of hypothalamic neuropeptides in rainbow trout and feeding behavior.

quote: At present, there exists an increased urgency of replacing fish meal with plant-based protein sources in the industrial application, and the key differences between fish meal and plant-based protein regarding the amount and ratio among essential amino acids are hard to reconcile, which prompts us to attach great importance to the regulatory mechanism of essential amino acids on food intake.
statement: 工业应用中用植物蛋白替代鱼粉的紧迫性增加，但两者在必需氨基酸含量和比例上的关键差异难以调和，这促使重视必需氨基酸对摄食的调节机制。
text_zh: 工业应用中用植物蛋白替代鱼粉的紧迫性增加，但两者在必需氨基酸含量和比例上的关键差异难以调和，这促使重视必需氨基酸对摄食的调节机制。
text_en: The urgency of replacing fishmeal with plant protein in industrial applications has increased, but the key differences in essential amino acid content and ratios between the two are difficult to reconcile, which has prompted attention to the regulatory mechanisms of essential amino acids on feeding.
limitations: 必需氨基酸含量和比例差异难以调和

quote: we screened out five effective essential amino acids (leucine, valine, histidine, lysine, and methionine) that can have a long-lasting effect on the food intake of mandarin fish.
statement: 筛选出五种必需氨基酸（亮氨酸、缬氨酸、组氨酸、赖氨酸和蛋氨酸）对鳜鱼的摄食量具有持久影响。
text_zh: 筛选出五种必需氨基酸（亮氨酸、缬氨酸、组氨酸、赖氨酸和蛋氨酸）对鳜鱼的摄食量具有持久影响。
text_en: Five essential amino acids (leucine, valine, histidine, lysine and methionine) were screened out as having a persistent effect on the feed intake of mandarin fish.

quote: RT-PCR analysis revealed that npy and cart mRNAs mostly changed according to the increased food intake induced by lysine ( Figure 1 B).
statement: RT-PCR分析显示，npy和cart mRNA的变化主要与赖氨酸诱导的摄食量增加有关。
text_zh: RT-PCR分析显示，npy和cart mRNA的变化主要与赖氨酸诱导的摄食量增加有关。
text_en: RT-PCR analysis showed that changes in npy and cart mRNA were mainly associated with increased feed intake induced by lysine.

quote: In the hypothalamus, the decreased mRNA level of orexigenic neuropeptide NPY has confirmed the anorectic effect of leucine in rainbow trout [ 19 , 20 ] and in mandarin fish [ 21 ].
statement: 在下丘脑中，促食欲神经肽NPY的mRNA水平降低证实了亮氨酸在虹鳟和鳜鱼中的厌食作用。
text_zh: 在下丘脑中，促食欲神经肽NPY的mRNA水平降低证实了亮氨酸在虹鳟和鳜鱼中的厌食作用。
text_en: Decreased mRNA levels of the appetite-stimulating neuropeptide NPY in the hypothalamus confirmed the anorectic effect of leucine in rainbow trout and mandarin fish.

quote: In vivo, as for lysine ICV injection, the brain could sense the amino acid levels of the central system, and also integrate the other signals from the peripheral system, such as energy status, and then regulate food intake.
statement: 在体内实验中，对于赖氨酸脑室注射，大脑可以感知中枢系统的氨基酸水平，并整合来自外周系统的其他信号（如能量状态），从而调节食物摄入。
text_zh: 在体内实验中，对于赖氨酸脑室注射，大脑可以感知中枢系统的氨基酸水平，并整合来自外周系统的其他信号（如能量状态），从而调节食物摄入。
text_en: In in vivo experiments, for intracerebroventricular lysine injection, the brain can sense amino acid levels in the central system and integrate other signals from the peripheral system (such as energy status) to regulate food intake.

quote: Taking atf4 as a representative factor of the GCN2 pathway, the similar trends of atf4 transcription were found upon lysine or methionine deprivation ( p 0.05) ( Figure 2 C).
statement: 以atf4作为GCN2通路的代表性因子，在赖氨酸或蛋氨酸缺乏下发现了相似的atf4转录趋势。
text_zh: 以atf4作为GCN2通路的代表性因子，在赖氨酸或蛋氨酸缺乏下发现了相似的atf4转录趋势。
text_en: Using atf4 as a representative factor of the GCN2 pathway, similar atf4 transcription trends were found under lysine or methionine deficiency.

quote: we discovered the regulation role of lysine and methionine on fish feeding through intracerebroventricular administration for the first time
statement: 本研究首次通过脑室内给药发现赖氨酸和蛋氨酸对鱼类摄食的调节作用。
text_zh: 本研究首次通过脑室内给药发现赖氨酸和蛋氨酸对鱼类摄食的调节作用。
text_en: This study is the first to discover the regulatory effects of lysine and methionine on fish feeding through intracerebroventricular administration.

quote: found that lysine and methionine could be the feeding-stimulating amino acids other than the reported valine
statement: 研究发现赖氨酸和蛋氨酸可能是除已报道的缬氨酸之外的促摄食氨基酸。
text_zh: 研究发现赖氨酸和蛋氨酸可能是除已报道的缬氨酸之外的促摄食氨基酸。
text_en: The study found that lysine and methionine may be feed-stimulating amino acids in addition to the previously reported valine.

quote: Latest findings provided further evidence that replacing fishmeal with plant protein in Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ) reduced growth performance [ 33 ]
statement: 最新研究结果进一步证明，在大西洋鲑中用植物蛋白替代鱼粉会降低生长性能。
text_zh: 最新研究结果进一步证明，在大西洋鲑中用植物蛋白替代鱼粉会降低生长性能。
text_en: The latest research results further prove that replacing fishmeal with plant protein in Atlantic salmon reduces growth performance.

quote: which might be explained by food intake decreasing gradually with increased fishmeal replacement levels [ 34 ]
statement: 这可能是由于随着鱼粉替代水平的增加，食物摄入量逐渐减少所致。
text_zh: 这可能是由于随着鱼粉替代水平的增加，食物摄入量逐渐减少所致。
text_en: This may be due to a gradual decrease in feed intake as the level of fishmeal replacement increases.

quote: However, the supplementation with lysine and methionine has improved the feed intake and growth of fish, such as rainbow trout [ 35 ]
statement: 然而，补充赖氨酸和蛋氨酸改善了虹鳟等鱼类的饲料摄入量和生长。
text_zh: 然而，补充赖氨酸和蛋氨酸改善了虹鳟等鱼类的饲料摄入量和生长。
text_en: However, supplementation with lysine and methionine improved feed intake and growth in fish such as rainbow trout.

quote: our results firstly confirmed the orexigenic roles of lysine and methionine in fish, besides their function of maintaining amino acid balance
statement: 我们的结果首先证实了赖氨酸和蛋氨酸在鱼类中的促食欲作用，除了它们维持氨基酸平衡的功能之外。
text_zh: 我们的结果首先证实了赖氨酸和蛋氨酸在鱼类中的促食欲作用，除了它们维持氨基酸平衡的功能之外。
text_en: Our results first confirmed the appetite-stimulating effects of lysine and methionine in fish, in addition to their function of maintaining amino acid balance.

quote: we examined the expression of npy / agrp or pomc / cart and found npy and cart mainly contribute to the regulation of lysine on food intake in mandarin fish ( Figure 1 B)
statement: 我们检测了npy/agrp或pomc/cart的表达，发现npy和cart主要有助于调节鳜鱼中赖氨酸对食物摄入的影响。
text_zh: 我们检测了npy/agrp或pomc/cart的表达，发现npy和cart主要有助于调节鳜鱼中赖氨酸对食物摄入的影响。
text_en: We detected the expression of npy/agrp or pomc/cart and found that npy and cart mainly contribute to regulating the effect of lysine on food intake in mandarin fish.

quote: Dietary amino acid restriction can be recognized by GCN2 signaling and suppress food intake [ 13 , 14 ].
statement: 膳食氨基酸限制可被GCN2信号识别并抑制食物摄入。
text_zh: 膳食氨基酸限制可被GCN2信号识别并抑制食物摄入。
text_en: Dietary amino acid restriction can be recognized by GCN2 signaling and inhibit food intake.

quote: Live prey fish, weighing 0.37 ± 0.05 g, were fed to mandarin fish, and the food intake was counted at 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 24 h after ICV administration.
statement: 向鳜鱼投喂活饵鱼，并在脑室给药后1、2、4、8、12和24小时统计摄食量。
text_zh: 向鳜鱼投喂活饵鱼，并在脑室给药后1、2、4、8、12和24小时统计摄食量。
text_en: Feed live bait fish to mandarin fish, and record feed intake at 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 24 hours after intracerebroventricular administration.
intervention: Live bait feeding and intake monitoring

quote: The experimental fish were anesthetized with MS-222 (200 mg/L) and euthanized.
statement: 实验鱼使用MS-222（200 mg/L）麻醉并实施安乐死。
text_zh: 实验鱼使用MS-222（200 mg/L）麻醉并实施安乐死。
text_en: The experimental fish were anesthetized and euthanized using MS-222 (200 mg/L).

quote: Before the start of the experiment, fish were temporarily cultured in a circulating aquaculture system tank (300 L) with pH of 7.0~8.5 and dissolved oxygen of 7.5~8.5 mg/L on a 12:12 h darkness cycle at (26 ± 1) °C and were fed with mrigal Cirrhinus mrigala juveniles at 9:00 am and 5:00 pm daily.
statement: 实验前，鱼在循环养殖系统水箱中暂养，控制pH值、溶解氧、光照周期和水温，并每日两次投喂幼鱼。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在循环养殖系统水箱中暂养，控制pH值、溶解氧、光照周期和水温，并每日两次投喂幼鱼。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were held in tanks of a recirculating aquaculture system, with control of pH, dissolved oxygen, light cycle and water temperature, and fed twice daily.

population.system: 循环水养殖系统 (circulating aquaculture system)

quote: The experimental fish were maintained in the tanks (50 × 40 × 40 cm) under the circulating water system and starved for 24 h before ICV administration.
statement: 实验鱼在循环水系统的鱼缸中维持，并在脑室内注射前禁食24小时。
text_zh: 实验鱼在循环水系统的鱼缸中维持，并在脑室内注射前禁食24小时。
text_en: Experimental fish were maintained in aquariums of a recirculating aquaculture system and fasted for 24 hours before intracerebroventricular injection.

quote: Fish were randomly divided into seven groups ( n = 12) and anesthetized by MS-222 (200 mg/L) (Millipore Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA).
statement: 鱼被随机分为七组，并使用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼被随机分为七组，并使用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were randomly divided into seven groups and anesthetized using MS-222.

quote: feed supplementation of leucine was also found to reduce food intake in a golden pompano ( Trachinotus ovatus )
statement: 饲料中添加亮氨酸被发现会减少金鲳鱼的食物摄入量。
text_zh: 饲料中添加亮氨酸被发现会减少金鲳鱼的食物摄入量。
text_en: Adding leucine to feed was found to reduce food intake in golden pompano.

quote: the intake of feed supplemented with tryptophan was promoted in Jian carp ( Cyprinus carpio var. Jian)
statement: 在建鲤的饲料中添加色氨酸促进了其食物摄入量。
text_zh: 在建鲤的饲料中添加色氨酸促进了其食物摄入量。
text_en: Adding tryptophan to the feed of growing carp promoted their food intake.

quote: Adding glutamine to the feed can also improve the body weight and food intake of Jian carp
statement: 在饲料中添加谷氨酰胺可以改善建鲤的体重和食物摄入量。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加谷氨酰胺可以改善建鲤的体重和食物摄入量。
text_en: Adding glutamine to feed can improve the body weight and food intake of Jian carp.

quote: the intracerebroventricular administration results revealed that lysine and methionine had positive and long-lasting effects on food intake, whereas tryptophan decreased the food intake temporarily
statement: 本研究的脑室内注射结果显示，赖氨酸和蛋氨酸对食物摄入有积极且持久的影响，而色氨酸暂时减少了食物摄入。
text_zh: 本研究的脑室内注射结果显示，赖氨酸和蛋氨酸对食物摄入有积极且持久的影响，而色氨酸暂时减少了食物摄入。
text_en: The intracerebroventricular injection results of this study showed that lysine and methionine had positive and lasting effects on food intake, while tryptophan temporarily reduced food intake.

quote: valine played the function of positive regulation in feeding, whereas leucine and histidine played the downregulating roles
statement: 缬氨酸在摄食中起正向调节作用，而亮氨酸和组氨酸起下调作用。
text_zh: 缬氨酸在摄食中起正向调节作用，而亮氨酸和组氨酸起下调作用。
text_en: Valine has a positive regulatory effect on feeding, while leucine and histidine have downregulatory effects.

quote: we illustrated the feeding regulation role of lysine and methionine in fish through intracerebroventricular administration for the first time.
statement: 本研究首次通过脑室内给药展示了赖氨酸和蛋氨酸在鱼类中的摄食调节作用。
text_zh: 本研究首次通过脑室内给药展示了赖氨酸和蛋氨酸在鱼类中的摄食调节作用。
text_en: This study is the first to demonstrate the feeding regulatory effects of lysine and methionine in fish through intracerebroventricular administration.

quote: Our study might be beneficial to strengthen the understanding of the relationship between the systematic amino acid sensing and food intake control by amino acid and provide a theoretical complement to the regulatory network of food intake in order to realize low-fishmeal feeding for mandarin fish and other carnivorous fish.
statement: 该研究可能有助于加强对系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸控制食物摄入之间关系的理解，并为实现鳜鱼及其他肉食性鱼类的低鱼粉喂养提供理论补充。
text_zh: 该研究可能有助于加强对系统性氨基酸感知与氨基酸控制食物摄入之间关系的理解，并为实现鳜鱼及其他肉食性鱼类的低鱼粉喂养提供理论补充。
text_en: This study may help strengthen the understanding of the relationship between systemic amino acid sensing and amino acid control of food intake, and provide theoretical supplementation for achieving low-fishmeal feeding in mandarin fish and other carnivorous fish.

population.species: mandarin fish and other carnivorous fish

quote: After the specific training procedure, partial individuals could accept dead prey fish and artificial diets.
statement: 经过特定的训练程序，部分鳜鱼个体能够接受死饵和人工饲料。
text_zh: 经过特定的训练程序，部分鳜鱼个体能够接受死饵和人工饲料。
text_en: Through specific training procedures, some mandarin fish individuals are able to accept dead bait and artificial feed.

quote: Additionally, we boldly assume that Npy activation increases in foraging and alters food choice to encounter beneficial foods in response to lysine deprivation.
statement: 此外，我们大胆假设，作为对赖氨酸剥夺的反应，Npy激活会增加觅食行为并改变食物选择以遇到有益食物。
text_zh: 此外，我们大胆假设，作为对赖氨酸剥夺的反应，Npy激活会增加觅食行为并改变食物选择以遇到有益食物。
text_en: In addition, we boldly hypothesize that, in response to lysine deprivation, Npy activation increases foraging behavior and alters food choice to encounter beneficial foods.

quote: the mandarin fish did not eat artificial diets during domestication processes were named Group W (n = 56), and the mandarin fish ate artificial diets were named Group X (n = 24) ( He et al., 2021 )
statement: 在驯化过程中，未摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼被命名为W组，而摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼被命名为X组。
text_zh: 在驯化过程中，未摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼被命名为W组，而摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼被命名为X组。
text_en: During the domestication process, mandarin fish that did not consume artificial feed were named Group W, while mandarin fish that consumed artificial feed were named Group X.

quote: Three fish were randomly selected from each group, anesthetized with MS-222 (200 mg/l) and euthanized.
statement: 从每组随机选取三条鱼，使用MS-222（200 mg/l）进行麻醉并实施安乐死。
text_zh: 从每组随机选取三条鱼，使用MS-222（200 mg/l）进行麻醉并实施安乐死。
text_en: Three fish were randomly selected from each group, anesthetized with MS-222 (200 mg/l), and euthanized.

quote: In our previous study, we found that DNA methylation could regulate the mRNA expression of t1r1 , further contributed to the feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to dead prey fish in mandarin fish ( Dou et al., 2018 ).
statement: 先前的研究发现，DNA甲基化可以调节t1r1的mRNA表达，从而促进鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，DNA甲基化可以调节t1r1的mRNA表达，从而促进鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化。
text_en: Previous studies have found that DNA methylation can regulate the mRNA expression of t1r1, thereby promoting the domestication of feeding habits in mandarin fish from live baitfish to dead baitfish.

quote: kept in tanks with continuous system of water filtration and aeration at constant temperature (25°C ± 1 C)
statement: Fish were kept in tanks with a continuous water filtration and aeration system at a constant temperature.
text_en: Fish were kept in tanks with a continuous water filtration and aeration system at a constant temperature.
intervention: Recirculating filtration, disinfection and aeration system
intervention_record: 循环过滤消毒增氧系统

quote: Mandarin fish (50 ± 5 g) were trained to accept artificial diets according to our previously published training procedure ( Liang et al., 2001 ; He et al., 2021 ).
statement: Fish were trained to accept artificial diets using a previously published procedure.
text_en: Fish were trained to accept artificial diets using a previously published procedure.

quote: To minimize possible suffering, the fish were anesthetized with MS-222 (200 mg/l) (Redmond, WA, United States) until loss of equilibrium.
statement: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 until loss of equilibrium to minimize suffering.
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 until loss of equilibrium to minimize suffering.

quote: After the specific training procedure ( Liang et al., 2001 ), some individuals could accept dead prey fish and artificial diets, but there are still some individuals could not.
statement: 经过特定的驯化程序后，一些个体可以接受死饵和人工饲料，但仍有一些个体不能。
text_zh: 经过特定的驯化程序后，一些个体可以接受死饵和人工饲料，但仍有一些个体不能。
text_en: After a specific acclimation procedure, some individuals can accept dead bait and artificial feed, but some individuals still cannot.

quote: In the present study, tbx2a and tbc1d20 were identified in the selected regions of mandarin fish which could be domesticated to accept artificial diets, suggesting that potential adaptive changes of vision might contribute to the feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to artificial diets in mandarin fish.
statement: 本研究发现鳜鱼驯化接受人工饲料的基因组选择区域包含tbx2a和tbc1d20基因，提示视觉适应性变化可能有助于从活饵到人工饲料的摄食习性驯化。
text_zh: 本研究发现鳜鱼驯化接受人工饲料的基因组选择区域包含tbx2a和tbc1d20基因，提示视觉适应性变化可能有助于从活饵到人工饲料的摄食习性驯化。
text_en: This study found that the genomic selection regions for mandarin fish acclimated to artificial feed include the tbx2a and tbc1d20 genes, suggesting that visual adaptive changes may contribute to the acclimation of feeding habits from live bait to artificial feed.

quote: In the present study, taar13c was identified in the selected regions of mandarin fish which could be domesticated to accept artificial diets, indicating that they might have higher tolerance to cadaverine in the fishmeal, thus displaying higher acceptance in artificial diets.
statement: 本研究发现鳜鱼驯化接受人工饲料的基因组选择区域包含taar13c基因，表明它们可能对鱼粉中的尸胺具有更高的耐受性，从而表现出更高的人工饲料接受度。
text_zh: 本研究发现鳜鱼驯化接受人工饲料的基因组选择区域包含taar13c基因，表明它们可能对鱼粉中的尸胺具有更高的耐受性，从而表现出更高的人工饲料接受度。
text_en: This study found that the genomic selection regions for mandarin fish acclimated to artificial feed include the taar13c gene, indicating that they may have higher tolerance to cadaverine in fish meal, thereby exhibiting higher acceptance of artificial feed.

quote: This would be beneficial for mandarin fish to adapt to the artificial diets.
statement: 上述机制有利于鳜鱼适应人工饲料。
text_zh: 上述机制有利于鳜鱼适应人工饲料。
text_en: The above mechanisms are beneficial for the adaptation of mandarin fish to artificial feed.

quote: And our previous study found the differential metabolites related to lipid metabolism between mandarin fish which could be domesticated to accept artificial diets and those could not ( He et al., 2021 ).
statement: 我们之前的研究发现，能够被驯化接受人工饲料的鳜鱼与不能接受人工饲料的鳜鱼之间，存在与脂质代谢相关的差异代谢物。
text_zh: 我们之前的研究发现，能够被驯化接受人工饲料的鳜鱼与不能接受人工饲料的鳜鱼之间，存在与脂质代谢相关的差异代谢物。
text_en: Our previous research found that there are differential metabolites related to lipid metabolism between mandarin fish that can be domesticated to accept artificial feed and those that cannot.

quote: 5,976 differentially methylated regions (DMRs) were identified between mandarin fish with different performance in accepting artificial diets
statement: 在鳜鱼中，根据接受人工饲料的表现差异鉴定出了5,976个差异甲基化区域。
text_zh: 在鳜鱼中，根据接受人工饲料的表现差异鉴定出了5,976个差异甲基化区域。
outcome: 摄食行为与表观遗传特征

quote: Combined feeding strategies increased the appetite of the mandarin fish hybrid, improved digestion and metabolism of formulated diets, and improved fish growth.
statement: 联合投喂策略增加了鳜鱼杂交种的食欲，改善了配合饲料的消化和代谢，并提高了鱼的生长。
text_zh: 联合投喂策略增加了鳜鱼杂交种的食欲，改善了配合饲料的消化和代谢，并提高了鱼的生长。
text_en: The combined feeding strategy increased the appetite of hybrid mandarin fish, improved the digestion and metabolism of formulated feed, and enhanced fish growth.

population.species: mandarin fish hybrid (Siniperca chuatsi ♀ × Siniperca scherzeri ♂)

intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂
outcome: 生长性能、消化代谢及食欲

quote: Weaning these hybrids to artificial feed resulted in poor growth probably due to improper digestive capabilities or low attractiveness of the non-mobile particles (Li et al., 2015, 2017).
statement: 将这些杂交种驯食人工饲料导致生长不良，这可能是由于消化能力不当或非移动颗粒吸引力低所致。
text_zh: 将这些杂交种驯食人工饲料导致生长不良，这可能是由于消化能力不当或非移动颗粒吸引力低所致。
text_en: Training these hybrids to eat artificial feed resulted in poor growth, which may be due to improper digestive capacity or low attractiveness of non-moving particles.

quote: In our study, co-feeding included both minced fish and formulated feeds, where fish were gradually weaned from live prey to an artificial diet allowing gradual adaptation to the physical and biochemical characteristics of the new diets
statement: 在本研究中，共同投喂包括碎鱼肉和配合饲料，鱼类从活饵逐渐过渡到人工饲料，从而允许对新饲料的物理和生化特性进行逐步适应。
text_zh: 在本研究中，共同投喂包括碎鱼肉和配合饲料，鱼类从活饵逐渐过渡到人工饲料，从而允许对新饲料的物理和生化特性进行逐步适应。
text_en: In this study, co-feeding included minced fish meat and formulated feed, with fish gradually transitioning from live bait to artificial feed, thereby allowing for gradual adaptation to the physical and biochemical characteristics of the new feed.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: The weight of the fish during the first 97 days showed decreasing trends in relation to the decreased ratio of minced fish; the trend of growth rate was the same.
statement: 在实验的前97天，鳜鱼杂交种的体重和生长速率随着饲料中碎鱼肉比例的降低而呈现下降趋势。
text_zh: 在实验的前97天，鳜鱼杂交种的体重和生长速率随着饲料中碎鱼肉比例的降低而呈现下降趋势。
text_en: During the first 97 days of the experiment, the body weight and growth rate of hybrid mandarin fish showed a decreasing trend as the proportion of minced fish meat in the feed decreased.

quote: During the next 97 days the average the weight of the fish fed Diet 1 was significantly lower than those fed Diet 2 (P < 0.05) and their growth rate subsequently decreased.
statement: 在接下来的97天里，饲喂日粮1的鱼平均体重显著低于饲喂日粮2的鱼，且其生长率随后下降。
text_zh: 在接下来的97天里，饲喂日粮1的鱼平均体重显著低于饲喂日粮2的鱼，且其生长率随后下降。
text_en: Over the next 97 days, the average body weight of fish fed diet 1 was significantly lower than that of fish fed diet 2, and their growth rate subsequently declined.

quote: The present experiment studied the effects of different ratios of formulated diets combined with minced fish on growth, digestion, and appetite-related gene expression of mandarin fish hybrid and attempted to find an appropriate method of transition.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨不同比例配合饲料与碎鱼混合对鳜杂交种生长、消化及食欲相关基因表达的影响，并试图找到一种合适的过渡方法。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨不同比例配合饲料与碎鱼混合对鳜杂交种生长、消化及食欲相关基因表达的影响，并试图找到一种合适的过渡方法。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the effects of different ratios of formulated feed mixed with chopped fish on the growth, digestion, and appetite-related gene expression of hybrid mandarin fish, and attempts to find a suitable transition method.

population.species: 鳜杂交种 (S. chuatsi ♀ × S. scherzeri ♂)

intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂
outcome: 生长性能、消化功能、食欲调节

quote: Prior to the experiment, the juveniles were fed with dead bait and acclimated to experimental conditions for 7 days.
statement: 实验前，幼鱼以死饵喂养并适应实验条件7天。
text_zh: 实验前，幼鱼以死饵喂养并适应实验条件7天。
text_en: Before the experiment, juvenile fish were fed dead bait and acclimated to experimental conditions for 7 days.

quote: The experimental fish were starved for 2 days to enhance their appetite and were then fed the experimental diets.
statement: 实验鱼禁食2天以增强其食欲，随后投喂实验日粮。
text_zh: 实验鱼禁食2天以增强其食欲，随后投喂实验日粮。
text_en: Experimental fish were fasted for 2 days to enhance their appetite, and then fed the experimental diet.

quote: Microfibrillar associated protein 4 (MFAP4) is an extracellular matrix protein, contributing to innate immune defense in teleosts ( Mohammadi et al., 2022 ), and mfap4 was reported to be significantly up-regulated in the stomach of artificial diet domesticated mandarin fish ( Shen et al., 2021 ).
statement: 微原纤维相关蛋白4（MFAP4）是一种细胞外基质蛋白，有助于硬骨鱼的先天免疫防御；据报道，mfap4在接受人工饲料驯化的鳜鱼胃部显著上调。
text_zh: 微原纤维相关蛋白4（MFAP4）是一种细胞外基质蛋白，有助于硬骨鱼的先天免疫防御；据报道，mfap4在接受人工饲料驯化的鳜鱼胃部显著上调。
text_en: Microfibril-associated protein 4 (MFAP4) is an extracellular matrix protein that contributes to the innate immune defense of teleost fish; mfap4 has been reported to be significantly upregulated in the stomach of mandarin fish acclimated to artificial feed.

quote: Fish were hand-fed to apparent satiation at 9:00 and 16:00.
statement: 鱼在9:00和16:00进行手喂至表观饱食。
text_zh: 鱼在9:00和16:00进行手喂至表观饱食。
text_en: Fish were hand-fed to apparent satiation at 9:00 and 16:00.

quote: During the experimental period, the temperature was 27.1 ± 2.0°C, and the dissolved oxygen was about 7.6 mg/L.
statement: 实验期间水温为27.1 ± 2.0°C，溶解氧约为7.6 mg/L。
text_zh: 实验期间水温为27.1 ± 2.0°C，溶解氧约为7.6 mg/L。
text_en: During the experimental period, the water temperature was 27.1 ± 2.0°C, and dissolved oxygen was about 7.6 mg/L.

quote: After 194 days, six fish per aquarium were anesthetized with Eugenol (1:10000) (Shanghai Reagent Corporation, China)
statement: 194天后，每个水族箱中的六条鱼使用丁香酚（1:10000）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 194天后，每个水族箱中的六条鱼使用丁香酚（1:10000）进行麻醉。
text_en: After 194 days, six fish in each aquarium were anesthetized using eugenol (1:10000).

quote: No significant difference was observed between fish fed Diets 2 and 3 (P > 0.05).
statement: 喂食日粮2和日粮3的鱼之间未观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 喂食日粮2和日粮3的鱼之间未观察到显著差异。
text_en: No significant difference was observed between fish fed diet 2 and diet 3.

quote: In contrast, the growth rate of fish fed Diet 2 was greater than the other treatment groups.
statement: 相比之下，喂食日粮2的鱼的生长率高于其他处理组。
text_zh: 相比之下，喂食日粮2的鱼的生长率高于其他处理组。
text_en: In contrast, the growth rate of fish fed diet 2 was higher than that of other treatment groups.

quote: Survival rate of the fish over 194 days ranged from 78.3% to 81.7% and was independent of experimental diets.
statement: 194天内鱼的存活率在78.3%至81.7%之间，且与实验日粮无关。
text_zh: 194天内鱼的存活率在78.3%至81.7%之间，且与实验日粮无关。
text_en: Fish survival rates ranged from 78.3% to 81.7% over 194 days and were unrelated to the experimental diets.

quote: This study examined the effects of a formulated diet combined with minced fish at ratios of 1:1 (Diet 1), 1:3 (Diet 2) and 0:1 (Diet 3) on growth, digestion, metabolism, and appetite of juvenile mandarin fish
statement: 本研究考察了配合饲料与碎鱼按不同比例混合投喂对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、消化、代谢和食欲的影响。
text_zh: 本研究考察了配合饲料与碎鱼按不同比例混合投喂对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、消化、代谢和食欲的影响。
text_en: This study examined the effects of feeding mandarin fish juveniles with mixtures of formulated feed and chopped fish at different ratios on their growth, digestion, metabolism, and appetite.

population.species: 杂交鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi ♀× Siniperca scherzeri ♂)

intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: Weight and growth rate of the fish in the first 97 days were negatively correlated to decreased ratio of minced fish.
statement: 在前97天内，鱼的体重和生长率与碎鱼比例的降低呈负相关。
text_zh: 在前97天内，鱼的体重和生长率与碎鱼比例的降低呈负相关。
text_en: During the first 97 days, fish body weight and growth rate were negatively correlated with the reduction in trash fish proportion.

quote: There was no significant difference in the growth of fish fed Diets 2 or 3.
statement: 饲喂Diet 2或Diet 3的鱼在生长方面没有显著差异。
text_zh: 饲喂Diet 2或Diet 3的鱼在生长方面没有显著差异。
text_en: Fish fed Diet 2 or Diet 3 showed no significant difference in growth.

quote: The activities of pepsin in the stomach, alanine transminase (ALT), and aspartate transminase (AST) in the liver, significantly increased in relation to the enhanced formulated diet ratio.
statement: 随着配合饲料比例的增加，胃蛋白酶活性以及肝脏中的丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)活性显著增加。
text_zh: 随着配合饲料比例的增加，胃蛋白酶活性以及肝脏中的丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)活性显著增加。
text_en: As the proportion of compound feed increased, pepsin activity and the activities of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the liver significantly increased.
outcome: 消化酶活性及肝酶指标

quote: The mRNA level of leptin in the liver and ghrelin in the stomach increased as the minced fish ratio decreased.
statement: 随着碎鱼比例的降低，肝脏中瘦素(leptin)和胃中饥饿素(ghrelin)的mRNA水平增加。
text_zh: 随着碎鱼比例的降低，肝脏中瘦素(leptin)和胃中饥饿素(ghrelin)的mRNA水平增加。
text_en: As the proportion of trash fish decreased, mRNA levels of leptin in the liver and ghrelin in the stomach increased.

quote: ALT and AST activity in liver significantly increased with the decrease of minced fish ratio.
statement: 肝脏中丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）活性随着碎鱼比例的降低而显著增加。
text_zh: 肝脏中丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）活性随着碎鱼比例的降低而显著增加。
text_en: The activities of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the liver significantly increased as the proportion of trash fish decreased.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: The mRNA level of leptin in the liver and ghrelin in stomach increased with the decrease of minced fish ratio and thereafter declined (Table 5).
statement: 肝脏中瘦素（leptin）和胃中饥饿素（ghrelin）的mRNA水平随着碎鱼比例的降低而增加，随后下降。
text_zh: 肝脏中瘦素（leptin）和胃中饥饿素（ghrelin）的mRNA水平随着碎鱼比例的降低而增加，随后下降。
text_en: The mRNA levels of leptin in the liver and ghrelin in the stomach increased as the proportion of trash fish decreased, then declined.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: Amylase activity in the stomach and intestine significantly decreased in relation to the increase of formulated diet ratio.
statement: 胃和肠中的淀粉酶活性随饲料配方比例的增加而显著降低。
text_zh: 胃和肠中的淀粉酶活性随饲料配方比例的增加而显著降低。
text_en: Amylase activity in the stomach and intestine decreased significantly with an increase in the feed formulation ratio.

quote: Growth of juvenile mandarin fish hybrids was enhanced in the early co-feeding treatments as the palatability and digestibility of minced fish was better compared to artificial diets.
statement: 在早期共同投喂处理中，由于碎鱼的适口性和消化率优于人工饲料，杂交鳜鱼幼鱼的生长得到增强。
text_zh: 在早期共同投喂处理中，由于碎鱼的适口性和消化率优于人工饲料，杂交鳜鱼幼鱼的生长得到增强。
text_en: In the early co-feeding treatment, growth of juvenile hybrid mandarin fish was enhanced because minced fish had better palatability and digestibility than artificial feed.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: Therefore, mixed diets with higher formulated diet ratios resulted in significant improvement of growth performance at the end of experiment, and the gene expression of IGF-I in the liver paralleled fish growth.
statement: 因此，含有较高比例配方饲料的混合饲料在实验结束时显著改善了生长性能，且肝脏中IGF-I基因的表达与鱼体生长平行。
text_zh: 因此，含有较高比例配方饲料的混合饲料在实验结束时显著改善了生长性能，且肝脏中IGF-I基因的表达与鱼体生长平行。
text_en: Therefore, mixed diets containing a higher proportion of formulated feed significantly improved growth performance at the end of the experiment, and hepatic IGF-I gene expression paralleled fish body growth.

quote: In this experiment, protease activity of mandarin fish hybrid fed Diet 2 was significantly higher than in the fish fed Diets 1 or 3.
statement: 在本实验中，饲喂Diet 2的杂交鳜鱼的蛋白酶活性显著高于饲喂Diet 1或Diet 3的鱼。
text_zh: 在本实验中，饲喂Diet 2的杂交鳜鱼的蛋白酶活性显著高于饲喂Diet 1或Diet 3的鱼。
text_en: In this experiment, the protease activity of hybrid mandarin fish fed Diet 2 was significantly higher than that of fish fed Diet 1 or Diet 3.

quote: This increase in protease activity may explain why growth of fish fed Diet 2 was better (Caruso et al., 1993; Chong et al., 2002).
statement: 蛋白酶活性的增加可能解释了为什么饲喂Diet 2的鱼生长更好。
text_zh: 蛋白酶活性的增加可能解释了为什么饲喂Diet 2的鱼生长更好。
text_en: The increase in protease activity may explain why fish fed Diet 2 grew better.

quote: Co-feeding may have helped mandarin fish hybrids accept the formulated diets and improve their digestive capacity.
statement: 共同投喂可能帮助杂交鳜鱼接受配方饲料并提高其消化能力。
text_zh: 共同投喂可能帮助杂交鳜鱼接受配方饲料并提高其消化能力。
text_en: Co-feeding may help hybrid mandarin fish accept formulated feed and improve their digestive ability.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: They were able to ingest and digest the diets more easily.
statement: 它们能够更容易地摄入和消化饲料。
text_zh: 它们能够更容易地摄入和消化饲料。
text_en: They are able to ingest and digest feed more easily.
intervention: Co-feeding fish mince and formulated feed
intervention_record: 碎鱼肉与配合饲料共喂

quote: 在高密度的养殖条件下, 这种单殖吸虫在级种群中有着很高的感染率, 并摄食宿主粘液、鳃组织和血液, 引起养殖条件下级的疾病, 危害级的养殖生产
statement: 在高密度养殖条件下，河妒锚首吸虫对鲤种群的感染率很高，通过摄食宿主粘液、鳃组织和血液引起疾病，危害养殖生产。
text_zh: 在高密度养殖条件下，河妒锚首吸虫对鲤种群的感染率很高，通过摄食宿主粘液、鳃组织和血液引起疾病，危害养殖生产。
text_en: Under high-density farming conditions, the infection rate of Gyrodactylus cypri in carp populations is very high, causing disease by feeding on host mucus, gill tissue, and blood, thereby harming aquaculture production.

quote: In addition to its taxonomic distinctiveness, the strain exhibits notable extracellular antioxidant activity supported by a repertoire of intracellular oxidative defense genes, suggesting a potential ecological role in mitigating oxidative stress in the fish gut.
statement: 该菌株表现出显著的胞外抗氧化活性，并由一系列胞内氧化防御基因支持，暗示其在缓解鱼类肠道氧化应激方面具有潜在的生态作用。
text_zh: 该菌株表现出显著的胞外抗氧化活性，并由一系列胞内氧化防御基因支持，暗示其在缓解鱼类肠道氧化应激方面具有潜在的生态作用。
text_en: This strain exhibits significant extracellular antioxidant activity, supported by a series of intracellular oxidative defense genes, suggesting its potential ecological role in alleviating intestinal oxidative stress in fish.

quote:
This study found that the growth of fish in the first 97 days showed decreasing trends in
relation to the decreased ratio of minced fish.
statement: 研究发现，在前97天内，随着碎鱼比例的降低，鱼的生长呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 研究发现，在前97天内，随着碎鱼比例的降低，鱼的生长呈下降趋势。
text_en: The study found that during the first 97 days, fish growth showed a downward trend as the proportion of trash fish decreased.

quote:
At the end of 97 days, the growth of fish
showed increasing trends in relation to the decreased ratio of minced fish.
statement: 在97天结束时，随着碎鱼比例的降低，鱼的生长呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 在97天结束时，随着碎鱼比例的降低，鱼的生长呈上升趋势。
text_en: At the end of 97 days, fish growth showed an upward trend as the proportion of trash fish decreased.

quote:
Results
indicated that growth of mandarin fish hybrid improved, and co-feeding increased the
acceptability of artificial diets when live feeds are gradually withdrawn.
statement: 结果表明，当逐渐撤除活饵时，共投喂改善了鳜杂交种的生长并提高了人工饲料的可接受性。
text_zh: 结果表明，当逐渐撤除活饵时，共投喂改善了鳜杂交种的生长并提高了人工饲料的可接受性。
text_en: The results showed that when live bait was gradually withdrawn, co-feeding improved the growth of hybrid mandarin fish and increased the acceptability of artificial feed.
intervention: Co-feeding live bait and artificial feed with gradual withdrawal
intervention_record: 活饵与人工饲料共投喂并逐步撤除活饵

quote:
Improved growth
when live feeds were combined with microdiets has also been reported for cobia
Rachycenton canadum (Nhu et al., 2010), loach Misgurnus anguillicaudatus (Wang et al.,
2009), tongue sole Cynoglossus semilaevis (Chang et al., 2006) and Senegalese sole
Solea senegalensis (Engrola et al., 2009).
statement: 据报道，在大黄鱼、泥鳅、半滑舌鳎和塞内加尔鳎中，将活饵与微颗粒饲料结合使用也能改善生长。
text_zh: 据报道，在大黄鱼、泥鳅、半滑舌鳎和塞内加尔鳎中，将活饵与微颗粒饲料结合使用也能改善生长。
text_en: It is reported that combining live feed with micro-particle feed also improves growth in large yellow croaker, loach, tongue sole, and Senegalese sole.

population.species: cobia, loach, tongue sole, Senegalese sole

intervention: Feeding live bait together with formulated feed
intervention_record: 活饵与配合饲料一起投喂

quote:
It was reported that live feed given together
with a formulated diet could enhance the efficiency of the formulated diet by promoting
the assimilation and deposition of dietary nutrients in the fish body (Kolkovski et al.,
1997).
statement: 据报道，活饵与配合饲料一起投喂可以通过促进鱼类体内营养物质的同化和沉积来提高配合饲料的效率。
text_zh: 据报道，活饵与配合饲料一起投喂可以通过促进鱼类体内营养物质的同化和沉积来提高配合饲料的效率。
text_en: It is reported that feeding live bait together with formulated feed can improve the efficiency of formulated feed by promoting the assimilation and deposition of nutrients in fish.
intervention: Feeding live bait together with formulated feed
intervention_record: 活饵与配合饲料一起投喂

quote: The inhibited activity of PK in fish fed formulated diets may occur because carnivorous mandarin fish hybrids have a low capacity for carbohydrate regulation.
statement: 喂食配合饲料的鱼中PK活性受到抑制可能是因为肉食性的鳜鱼杂交种对碳水化合物的调节能力较低。
text_zh: 喂食配合饲料的鱼中PK活性受到抑制可能是因为肉食性的鳜鱼杂交种对碳水化合物的调节能力较低。
text_en: The inhibition of PK activity in fish fed formulated feed may be because the carnivorous hybrid mandarin fish has a lower ability to regulate carbohydrates.

quote: In this study, ALT and AST activity significantly increased with the increase of formulated diet ratio.
statement: 在本研究中，ALT和AST活性随着配合饲料比例的增加而显著增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，ALT和AST活性随着配合饲料比例的增加而显著增加。
text_en: In this study, ALT and AST activities increased significantly with increasing proportions of formulated feed.

quote: Infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) is the type species of the genus Megalocytivirus in the Iridoviridae family [ 13 ], which is highly lethal in Chinese perch ( Siniperca chuatsi ) and can cause great economic losses [ 14 , 15 ].
statement: 传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）对鳜鱼具有高度致死性，并可能导致巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）对鳜鱼具有高度致死性，并可能导致巨大的经济损失。
text_en: Infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) is highly lethal to mandarin fish and may cause huge economic losses.

quote: ISKNV causes severe disease in cultivated mandarin fish
statement: ISKNV导致养殖鳜鱼发生严重疾病。
text_zh: ISKNV导致养殖鳜鱼发生严重疾病。
text_en: ISKNV causes severe disease in farmed mandarin fish.

quote: The mortality of affected farmed mandarin fish can reach 100% within 7–10 days after an outbreak, and the spleen and kidney appear to be the major organs affected by the virus.
statement: 受感染养殖鳜鱼在爆发后7-10天内死亡率可达100%，脾脏和肾脏似乎是受病毒影响的主要器官。
text_zh: 受感染养殖鳜鱼在爆发后7-10天内死亡率可达100%，脾脏和肾脏似乎是受病毒影响的主要器官。
text_en: The mortality rate of infected farmed mandarin fish can reach 100% within 7-10 days after an outbreak, and the spleen and kidney appear to be the main organs affected by the virus.

quote: Infected fish usually display histopathological signs such as swelling and enlargement after infection
statement: 感染后的鱼通常表现出肿胀和增大等组织病理学迹象。
text_zh: 感染后的鱼通常表现出肿胀和增大等组织病理学迹象。
text_en: Fish after infection usually show histopathological signs such as swelling and enlargement.

quote: However, there is currently no vaccine or no other strategies to effectively prevent ISKNV infection.
statement: 目前尚无疫苗或其他策略能有效预防ISKNV感染。
text_zh: 目前尚无疫苗或其他策略能有效预防ISKNV感染。
text_en: Currently, there is no vaccine or other strategy that can effectively prevent ISKNV infection.
intervention_record: 疫苗接种及其他预防策略

quote: ISKNV replication was inhibited by BPTES and EGCG, suggesting they or their analogs may be promising compounds for prevention of ISKNV infection.
statement: BPTES和EGCG抑制了ISKNV的复制，表明它们或其类似物可能是预防ISKNV感染的有前景的化合物。
text_zh: BPTES和EGCG抑制了ISKNV的复制，表明它们或其类似物可能是预防ISKNV感染的有前景的化合物。
text_en: BPTES and EGCG inhibited ISKNV replication, indicating that they or their analogues may be promising compounds for preventing ISKNV infection.

quote: The upregulation of NPY was observed in the brain of mandarin fish hybrid fed diets with increased formulated diet ratio.
statement: 在喂食增加配合饲料比例日粮的鳜鱼杂交种大脑中观察到NPY的上调。
text_zh: 在喂食增加配合饲料比例日粮的鳜鱼杂交种大脑中观察到NPY的上调。
text_en: Upregulation of NPY was observed in the brains of hybrid mandarin fish fed a diet with an increased proportion of formulated feed.

quote: Glutathione plays a prominent role in the defense against oxidative stress.
statement: 谷胱甘肽在对抗氧化应激防御中起着突出作用。
text_zh: 谷胱甘肽在对抗氧化应激防御中起着突出作用。
text_en: Glutathione plays a prominent role in the defense against oxidative stress.

quote: mandarin fish was reported to exhibit anorexia and hepatic steatosis after subjected to a diet rich in carbohydrates
statement: 据报道，鳜鱼在摄入高碳水化合物饮食后会出现厌食和肝脏脂肪变性。
text_zh: 据报道，鳜鱼在摄入高碳水化合物饮食后会出现厌食和肝脏脂肪变性。
text_en: It is reported that mandarin fish exhibit anorexia and hepatic steatosis after consuming a high-carbohydrate diet.

quote: Previous study has reported that including dietary betaine can reduce could mitigate the oxidative status and apoptosis induced by diet rich in high carbohydrate in mandarin fish
statement: 先前的研究报道，在鳜鱼的高碳水化合物饮食中添加甜菜碱可以减轻氧化状态和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道，在鳜鱼的高碳水化合物饮食中添加甜菜碱可以减轻氧化状态和细胞凋亡。
text_en: Previous studies reported that adding betaine to high-carbohydrate diets for mandarin fish can alleviate oxidative status and apoptosis.

quote: Notably, betaine has been shown to function as a feed attractant, promoting feed intake in aquatic animals, including the mandarin fish [ 20 ].
statement: 甜菜碱被证明可作为一种饲料引诱剂，促进包括鳜鱼在内的水生动物的摄食。
text_zh: 甜菜碱被证明可作为一种饲料引诱剂，促进包括鳜鱼在内的水生动物的摄食。
text_en: Betaine has been proven to act as a feed attractant, promoting feeding in aquatic animals including mandarin fish.

quote: In black seabream ( Acanthopagrus schlegelii ), dietary betaine has been found to alleviate the high fat diet induced liver steatosis and inflammation [ 22 ].
statement: 在黑鲷中，膳食补充甜菜碱被发现能缓解高脂饮食诱导的肝脏脂肪变性和炎症。
text_zh: 在黑鲷中，膳食补充甜菜碱被发现能缓解高脂饮食诱导的肝脏脂肪变性和炎症。
text_en: In black seabream, dietary betaine supplementation was found to alleviate high-fat diet-induced hepatic steatosis and inflammation.

quote: It is therefore likely that glutathione is involved in oxidative stress activated by ISKNV infection.
statement: 因此，谷胱甘肽很可能参与由ISKNV感染激活的氧化应激。
text_zh: 因此，谷胱甘肽很可能参与由ISKNV感染激活的氧化应激。
text_en: Therefore, glutathione is likely involved in oxidative stress activated by ISKNV infection.

population.species: CPB (中华鳑鲏/相关鱼类细胞)

quote: Research have shown that hyperglycemia may result in reduced food intake in fish and mammals fed a HC diet
statement: 研究表明，高血糖可能导致喂食高碳水化合物饮食的鱼类和哺乳动物食物摄入量减少。
text_zh: 研究表明，高血糖可能导致喂食高碳水化合物饮食的鱼类和哺乳动物食物摄入量减少。
text_en: Studies show that hyperglycemia may lead to reduced food intake in fish and mammals fed a high-carbohydrate diet.

quote: Compared to omnivorous and herbivorous species, carnivorous fish have a high intolerance for carbohydrates in diets
statement: 与杂食性和草食性物种相比，肉食性鱼类对日粮中的碳水化合物具有高度不耐受性。
text_zh: 与杂食性和草食性物种相比，肉食性鱼类对日粮中的碳水化合物具有高度不耐受性。
text_en: Compared to omnivorous and herbivorous species, carnivorous fish have a high intolerance to dietary carbohydrates.

quote: Consequently, high carbohydrate (HC) diets invariably induce growth retardation and atypical regulation of intermediary metabolism, including the metabolic syndrome such as persistent postprandial hyperglycaemia and hepatic steatosis in aquatic animals
statement: 因此，高碳水化合物（HC）日粮不可避免地导致水生动物生长迟缓和中间代谢的非典型调节，包括持续餐后高血糖和肝脂肪变性等代谢综合征。
text_zh: 因此，高碳水化合物（HC）日粮不可避免地导致水生动物生长迟缓和中间代谢的非典型调节，包括持续餐后高血糖和肝脂肪变性等代谢综合征。
text_en: Therefore, high-carbohydrate (HC) diets inevitably lead to growth retardation and atypical regulation of intermediate metabolism in aquatic animals, including metabolic syndromes such as persistent postprandial hyperglycemia and hepatic steatosis.

quote: Additionally, several reports have reported a reduction on food intake in carnivorous fish after being exposed to diet rich in carbohydrate
statement: 此外，几份报告指出，肉食性鱼类在暴露于富含碳水化合物的日粮后，摄食量减少。
text_zh: 此外，几份报告指出，肉食性鱼类在暴露于富含碳水化合物的日粮后，摄食量减少。
text_en: In addition, several reports indicate that carnivorous fish reduce feed intake after exposure to carbohydrate-rich diets.

quote: juvenile mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ), already adapted to consuming artificial diets, were acclimated to the rearing environments for two weeks.
statement: 幼体鳜鱼在适应人工饲料后，在养殖环境中进行了两周的驯化。
text_zh: 幼体鳜鱼在适应人工饲料后，在养殖环境中进行了两周的驯化。
text_en: After juvenile mandarin fish adapted to artificial feed, they underwent two weeks of environmental acclimation in the farming environment.

quote: Following a 24-h fast, 300 healthy mandarin fish (initial weight, 23.73 ± 0.05 g) were assigned to four groups at random.
statement: 经过24小时禁食后，300条健康的鳜鱼被随机分配到四个组中。
text_zh: 经过24小时禁食后，300条健康的鳜鱼被随机分配到四个组中。
text_en: After 24 hours of fasting, 300 healthy mandarin fish were randomly assigned to four groups.

quote: fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily, using the four experimental diets at 08:30 and 16:00.
statement: 鱼类每天两次（08:30和16:00）投喂四种实验饲料至表观饱食。
text_zh: 鱼类每天两次（08:30和16:00）投喂四种实验饲料至表观饱食。
text_en: Fish were fed four experimental diets to apparent satiation twice daily (08:30 and 16:00).

quote: During the eight-week rearing period, regular monitoring was conducted on water quality parameters, including temperature (maintained at 27.0–28.5 °C), total ammonia nitrogen ( 0.1 mg/L), dissolved oxygen (4.6–5.5 mg/L), and pH (7.0–8.5).
statement: 在八周的养殖期间，对水质参数进行了定期监测，包括温度、总氨氮、溶解氧和pH值。
text_zh: 在八周的养殖期间，对水质参数进行了定期监测，包括温度、总氨氮、溶解氧和pH值。
text_en: During the eight-week farming period, water quality parameters were regularly monitored, including temperature, total ammonia nitrogen, dissolved oxygen, and pH.

quote: MS-222 (60 mg/L, Sigma, USA) was used to the anesthetize the fish.
statement: 使用MS-222（60 mg/L）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 使用MS-222（60 mg/L）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized using MS-222 (60 mg/L).

quote: Diets with high carbohydrate (HC) was reported to have influence on appetite and intermediary metabolism in fish.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食被报道会影响鱼类的食欲和中间代谢。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食被报道会影响鱼类的食欲和中间代谢。
text_en: High-carbohydrate diets have been reported to affect the appetite and intermediate metabolism of fish.

quote: The results suggested that betaine enhanced feed intake by regulating the hypothalamic appetite genes.
statement: 结果表明甜菜碱通过调节下丘脑食欲基因增强了采食量。
text_zh: 结果表明甜菜碱通过调节下丘脑食欲基因增强了采食量。
text_en: The results showed that betaine enhanced feed intake by regulating hypothalamic appetite genes.

quote: The HC diet-induced downregulation of AMPK and appetite genes was also positively correlated with the decreased autophagy genes, suggesting a possible mechanism that AMPK/mTOR signaling might regulate appetite through autophagy.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食诱导的AMPK和食欲基因下调与自噬基因减少呈正相关，提示AMPK/mTOR信号通路可能通过自噬调节食欲。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食诱导的AMPK和食欲基因下调与自噬基因减少呈正相关，提示AMPK/mTOR信号通路可能通过自噬调节食欲。
text_en: The downregulation of AMPK and appetite genes induced by a high-carbohydrate diet is positively correlated with reduced autophagy genes, suggesting that the AMPK/mTOR signaling pathway may regulate appetite through autophagy.

quote: demonstrated the feasibility of betaine as an aquafeed additive to regulate appetite and intermediary metabolism in fish.
statement: 证明了甜菜碱作为水产饲料添加剂调节鱼类食欲和中间代谢的可行性。
text_zh: 证明了甜菜碱作为水产饲料添加剂调节鱼类食欲和中间代谢的可行性。
text_en: Demonstrated the feasibility of betaine as an aquaculture feed additive in regulating fish appetite and intermediate metabolism.

quote: dietary betaine usage in the HC diet significantly increased the npy and agrp2 mRNA levels while decreased the cart mRNA levels in the HC + BET group
statement: 在高碳水化合物饮食中添加甜菜碱显著增加了HC+BET组中npy和agrp2的mRNA水平，同时降低了cart的mRNA水平。
text_zh: 在高碳水化合物饮食中添加甜菜碱显著增加了HC+BET组中npy和agrp2的mRNA水平，同时降低了cart的mRNA水平。
text_en: Adding betaine to a high-carbohydrate diet significantly increased the mRNA levels of npy and agrp2 in the HC+BET group, while decreasing the mRNA level of cart.
outcome: 摄食行为相关基因表达

quote: In terms of liver function indicators including AKP and ACP in the liver of mandarin fish, no significant variations were found between all groups ( P 0.05).
statement: 在包括碱性磷酸酶和酸性磷酸酶在内的肝功能指标方面，各组之间未发现显著差异。
text_zh: 在包括碱性磷酸酶和酸性磷酸酶在内的肝功能指标方面，各组之间未发现显著差异。
text_en: No significant differences were found among the groups in liver function indicators, including alkaline phosphatase and acid phosphatase.
intervention_record: 高脂饮食及甜菜碱处理

quote: the application of betaine in the HC diet significantly increased the feed intake (FI) of mandarin fish than the HC group ( P 0.05).
statement: 在高脂日粮中添加甜菜碱显著增加了鳜鱼的采食量。
text_zh: 在高脂日粮中添加甜菜碱显著增加了鳜鱼的采食量。
text_en: The addition of betaine to a high-fat diet significantly increased the feed intake of mandarin fish.

quote: Betaine is a well-known feeding stimulant for fish, and it is commonly used to enhance the flavor of chemical substances in feed, thereby increasing feed intake [ 29 ].
statement: 甜菜碱是鱼类中一种众所周知的摄食刺激剂，常用于增强饲料中化学物质的风味，从而增加采食量。
text_zh: 甜菜碱是鱼类中一种众所周知的摄食刺激剂，常用于增强饲料中化学物质的风味，从而增加采食量。
text_en: Betaine is a well-known feeding stimulant in fish, commonly used to enhance the flavor of chemicals in feed, thereby increasing feed intake.

quote: Dietary supplementation of betaine at an appropriate level has been reported to enhance feed intake in various aquatic species, such as grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ), black seabream ( Acanthopagrus schlegelii ), and Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) [ 21 , 30 , 31 ].
statement: 据报道，在适当水平下膳食补充甜菜碱可增强多种水生物种（如草鱼、黑鲷和尼罗罗非鱼）的采食量。
text_zh: 据报道，在适当水平下膳食补充甜菜碱可增强多种水生物种（如草鱼、黑鲷和尼罗罗非鱼）的采食量。
text_en: It is reported that dietary supplementation with betaine at appropriate levels can enhance feed intake in multiple aquatic species (such as grass carp, black seabream, and Nile tilapia).

population.species: 草鱼; 黑鲷; 尼罗罗非鱼

quote: In this study, compared to the HC group, a stimulation of food intake was observed in the HC + BET diet group of mandarin fish.
statement: 在本研究中，与HC组相比，鳜鱼的HC+BET日粮组观察到食物摄入量的刺激。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与HC组相比，鳜鱼的HC+BET日粮组观察到食物摄入量的刺激。
text_en: In this study, stimulation of feed intake was observed in the HC+BET diet group of mandarin fish compared to the HC group.
intervention_record: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱

quote: Accordingly, the orexigenic genes npy and agrp2 mRNA levels was significantly stimulated, and the anorexigenic genes cart mRNA levels was significantly suppressed in the hypothalamus of mandarin fish.
statement: 相应地，鳜鱼下丘脑中促食欲基因npy和agrp2的mRNA水平显著受到刺激，而抑食欲基因cart的mRNA水平显著受到抑制。
text_zh: 相应地，鳜鱼下丘脑中促食欲基因npy和agrp2的mRNA水平显著受到刺激，而抑食欲基因cart的mRNA水平显著受到抑制。
text_en: Accordingly, the mRNA levels of the orexigenic genes npy and agrp2 in the hypothalamus of Siniperca chuatsi were significantly stimulated, while the mRNA level of the anorexigenic gene cart was significantly inhibited.
intervention_record: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱

quote: These findings indicate that dietary supplementation of betaine affects the transcriptional expression of appetite genes in the hypothalamus, thereby improving feed intake of mandarin fish.
statement: 这些发现表明，膳食补充甜菜碱影响下丘脑中食欲基因的转录表达，从而改善鳜鱼的采食量。
text_zh: 这些发现表明，膳食补充甜菜碱影响下丘脑中食欲基因的转录表达，从而改善鳜鱼的采食量。
text_en: These findings indicate that dietary betaine supplementation affects the transcriptional expression of appetite genes in the hypothalamus, thereby improving feed intake in mandarin fish.

quote: Recently, there has been growing evidence that dietary betaine has hepatoprotective effects in both mammals and fish, as it reduces fat accumulation and alleviates hepatic steatosis [ 22 , 38 ].
statement: 近期有越来越多的证据表明，日粮甜菜碱对哺乳动物和鱼类具有肝脏保护作用，因为它能减少脂肪积累并缓解肝脂肪变性。
text_zh: 近期有越来越多的证据表明，日粮甜菜碱对哺乳动物和鱼类具有肝脏保护作用，因为它能减少脂肪积累并缓解肝脂肪变性。
text_en: There is increasing evidence that dietary betaine has hepatoprotective effects in mammals and fish, as it reduces fat accumulation and alleviates hepatic steatosis.

quote: In black seabream ( Acanthopagrus schlegelii ), dietary betaine supplementation worked as a lipid-lowering substance to alleviate high-fat diet-induced liver steatosis and mitigate inflammatory responses in fish [ 22 ].
statement: 在黑鲷中，日粮补充甜菜碱作为降脂物质，可缓解高脂饮食诱导的肝脏脂肪变性并减轻鱼类的炎症反应。
text_zh: 在黑鲷中，日粮补充甜菜碱作为降脂物质，可缓解高脂饮食诱导的肝脏脂肪变性并减轻鱼类的炎症反应。
text_en: In black seabream, dietary betaine supplementation as a lipid-lowering agent alleviates high-fat diet-induced hepatic steatosis and reduces inflammatory responses in fish.
outcome: 肝脏脂肪变性与炎症反应

quote: Subsequently, the significantly lower lipid droplets levels as evidenced by the Oil-Red O staining confirmed the results that dietary betaine alleviated the HC-diet induced liver lipid deposition in mandarin fish.
statement: 随后，油红O染色显示的显著较低的脂滴水平证实了日粮甜菜碱缓解了高碳水日粮诱导的鳜鱼肝脏脂质沉积。
text_zh: 随后，油红O染色显示的显著较低的脂滴水平证实了日粮甜菜碱缓解了高碳水日粮诱导的鳜鱼肝脏脂质沉积。
text_en: Subsequently, significantly lower lipid droplet levels shown by Oil Red O staining confirmed that dietary betaine alleviated hepatic lipid deposition induced by a high-carbohydrate diet in Chinese perch.

quote: Therefore, dietary betaine may alter the energy storage to hepatic glycogen rather than lipid, thus alleviating the HC diet-induced hepatic lipid over-deposition in mandarin fish.
statement: 膳食甜菜碱可能将能量储存改变为肝糖原而非脂质，从而缓解高碳水化合物日粮诱导的鳜鱼肝脏脂质过度沉积。
text_zh: 膳食甜菜碱可能将能量储存改变为肝糖原而非脂质，从而缓解高碳水化合物日粮诱导的鳜鱼肝脏脂质过度沉积。
text_en: Dietary betaine may shift energy storage from lipids to glycogen, thereby alleviating hepatic lipid over-accumulation induced by high-carbohydrate diets in mandarin fish.

quote: The findings revealed that betaine (at a concentration of 1%) enhanced appetite in mandarin fish fed a HC diet.
statement: 研究发现，在饲喂高碳水化合物日粮的鳜鱼中，1%浓度的甜菜碱增强了食欲。
text_zh: 研究发现，在饲喂高碳水化合物日粮的鳜鱼中，1%浓度的甜菜碱增强了食欲。
text_en: The study found that in mandarin fish fed a high-carbohydrate diet, 1% betaine enhanced appetite.

quote: Meanwhile, the incorporating betaine into the HC diet relieved the HC-induced hepatic lipid deposition and led to changes of the energy storage form.
statement: 同时，在高碳水化合物日粮中添加甜菜碱缓解了高碳水化合物诱导的肝脏脂质沉积，并导致能量储存形式的变化。
text_zh: 同时，在高碳水化合物日粮中添加甜菜碱缓解了高碳水化合物诱导的肝脏脂质沉积，并导致能量储存形式的变化。
text_en: At the same time, adding betaine to a high-carbohydrate diet alleviated high-carbohydrate-induced hepatic lipid deposition and led to changes in energy storage forms.

quote: Ingestion of a high-carbohydrate diet has been reported to lead to hepatic lipid deposition in various fish species, including grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ), gibel carp ( Carassius gibelio ), as well as mandarin fish [ 3 , 4 , 24 ].
statement: 据报道，摄入高碳水化合物饮食会导致包括草鱼、鲫鱼和鳜鱼在内的多种鱼类出现肝脏脂质沉积。
text_zh: 据报道，摄入高碳水化合物饮食会导致包括草鱼、鲫鱼和鳜鱼在内的多种鱼类出现肝脏脂质沉积。
text_en: It is reported that high-carbohydrate diets lead to hepatic lipid deposition in various fish species, including grass carp, crucian carp, and mandarin fish.

population.species: grass carp, gibel carp, mandarin fish

quote: In fish, it has been demonstrated that the activation or inhibition of mTOR signaling can restrain or trigger food intake by modifying the anorexigenic POMC protein levels [ 28 ].
statement: 在鱼类中，已证明mTOR信号通路的激活或抑制可以通过改变厌食性POMC蛋白水平来抑制或触发摄食。
text_zh: 在鱼类中，已证明mTOR信号通路的激活或抑制可以通过改变厌食性POMC蛋白水平来抑制或触发摄食。
text_en: In fish, activation or inhibition of the mTOR signaling pathway has been shown to suppress or trigger feeding by altering anorexigenic POMC protein levels.

quote: The HC diet has also been reported to reduce ingestion in fish including rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss Walbaum) and mandarin fish [ 5 , 6 ].
statement: 据报道，高碳（HC）饮食会降低包括虹鳟和鳜鱼在内的鱼类的摄入量。
text_zh: 据报道，高碳（HC）饮食会降低包括虹鳟和鳜鱼在内的鱼类的摄入量。
text_en: It is reported that high-carbohydrate (HC) diets reduce feed intake in fish, including rainbow trout and mandarin fish.

quote: In this study, although no significant variations concerning feed intake (FI) were found between mandarin fish fed the NC and HC diet, some events linking the gene expression of AMPK/mTOR signaling, autophagy and appetite regulation and the phenotype of feed intake displayed positively related to some extent.
statement: 在本研究中，尽管喂食正常碳（NC）和高碳（HC）饮食的鳜鱼之间在采食量方面没有发现显著差异，但连接AMPK/mTOR信号、自噬和食欲调节基因表达与采食量表型的一些事件在一定程度上呈正相关。
text_zh: 在本研究中，尽管喂食正常碳（NC）和高碳（HC）饮食的鳜鱼之间在采食量方面没有发现显著差异，但连接AMPK/mTOR信号、自噬和食欲调节基因表达与采食量表型的一些事件在一定程度上呈正相关。
text_en: In this study, although no significant difference in feed intake was found between mandarin fish fed normal carbon (NC) and high carbon (HC) diets, some events linking AMPK/mTOR signaling, autophagy, and appetite-regulating gene expression to the feed intake phenotype were positively correlated to some extent.
limitations: no significant variations concerning feed intake (FI) were found

quote: In addition, the inhibition of AMPK by the HC diet led to upregulation of anorexigenic genes cart and pomc and downregulation of orexigenic genes npy in the hypothalamus, resulting in inhibition of appetite in mandarin fish.
statement: 此外，高碳饮食对AMPK的抑制导致下丘脑中厌食基因cart和pomc的上调以及促食基因npy的下调，从而抑制了鳜鱼的食欲。
text_zh: 此外，高碳饮食对AMPK的抑制导致下丘脑中厌食基因cart和pomc的上调以及促食基因npy的下调，从而抑制了鳜鱼的食欲。
text_en: In addition, the inhibition of AMPK by a high-carbohydrate diet led to the upregulation of anorexigenic genes cart and pomc in the hypothalamus and the downregulation of the orexigenic gene npy, thereby suppressing the appetite of mandarin fish.

quote: prolonged ingestion of high carbohydrate diets can lead to metabolic disorders in glucose homoeostasis in aquatic species
statement: 长期摄入高碳水化合物饲料可能导致水生动物葡萄糖稳态的代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 长期摄入高碳水化合物饲料可能导致水生动物葡萄糖稳态的代谢紊乱。
text_en: Long-term consumption of high-carbohydrate diets may lead to metabolic disorders in glucose homeostasis in aquatic animals.

quote: Despite the HC diet-induced oxidative status and apoptotic responses, it also significantly elevated the hepatic AMPK and mTOR mRNA levels in mandarin fish.
statement: 尽管高碳水化合物（HC）饲料诱导了氧化状态和凋亡反应，但它也显著提高了鳜鱼肝脏中AMPK和mTOR的mRNA水平。
text_zh: 尽管高碳水化合物（HC）饲料诱导了氧化状态和凋亡反应，但它也显著提高了鳜鱼肝脏中AMPK和mTOR的mRNA水平。
text_en: Although high-carbohydrate (HC) diets induced oxidative stress and apoptosis responses, they also significantly increased the mRNA levels of AMPK and mTOR in the liver of Siniperca chuatsi.
outcome: 氧化应激、细胞凋亡及信号通路表达

quote: The Chinese perch was purchased from Poyang Le'an Special Aquaculture Co., Ltd., and was acclimated for 1 month before the main trial, using commercial feed in the early stages, and control feed in the later stages
statement: 鳜鱼在正式试验前进行了为期1个月的驯化，早期使用商业饲料，后期使用对照饲料。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在正式试验前进行了为期1个月的驯化，早期使用商业饲料，后期使用对照饲料。
text_en: Mandarin fish underwent a 1-month acclimation period before the formal trial, using commercial feed in the early stage and control feed in the later stage.

quote: Results showed that the weight gain rate and specific growth rate were significantly lower, and the feed conversion ratio was significantly higher in the D3 group than in fish fed D1 ( P 0.05), with no significant differences between the D1 and D2 groups ( P 0.05).
statement: 与对照组D1相比，高比例替代组D3的增重率和特定生长率显著降低，饲料转化率显著升高；而低比例替代组D2与D1之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 与对照组D1相比，高比例替代组D3的增重率和特定生长率显著降低，饲料转化率显著升高；而低比例替代组D2与D1之间无显著差异。
text_en: Compared to the control group D1, the weight gain rate and specific growth rate of the high-proportion replacement group D3 were significantly reduced, and the feed conversion ratio was significantly increased; while there was no significant difference between the low-proportion replacement group D2 and D1.

quote: The microbial community structure changed significantly.
statement: 肠道微生物群落结构发生了显著变化。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群落结构发生了显著变化。
text_en: The structure of the gut microbial community changed significantly.

quote: Mycoplasma showed the highest abundance in the D1 and D2 groups ( P 0.05), and Cetobacterium peaked in D2 group, and significantly higher than that in D1 group ( P 0.05).
statement: 支原体在D1和D2组丰度最高，而梭杆菌属在D2组达到峰值并显著高于D1组。
text_zh: 支原体在D1和D2组丰度最高，而梭杆菌属在D2组达到峰值并显著高于D1组。
text_en: Mycoplasma had the highest abundance in groups D1 and D2, while Fusobacterium peaked in group D2 and was significantly higher than in group D1.

quote: In conclusion, under the experimental conditions, the replacement of 27.27% of fish meal by the compound protein did not have a negative impact on the growth performance of Chinese perch and could improve muscle quality, lipid metabolism, and the interaction of intestinal microbiota.
statement: 在实验条件下，使用复合蛋白替代27.27%的鱼粉未对鳜鱼生长性能产生负面影响，并能改善肌肉品质、脂质代谢及肠道菌群相互作用。
text_zh: 在实验条件下，使用复合蛋白替代27.27%的鱼粉未对鳜鱼生长性能产生负面影响，并能改善肌肉品质、脂质代谢及肠道菌群相互作用。
text_en: Under experimental conditions, replacing 27.27% of fish meal with composite protein did not negatively affect the growth performance of mandarin fish, and improved muscle quality, lipid metabolism, and gut microbiota interactions.
outcome: 生长性能、肌肉品质、脂质代谢、肠道菌群

quote: However, the sole plant or animal protein source has the disadvantages of amino acid composition imbalance and antinutritional factors, which always presented growth suppression, low feed utilization, and metabolic disorder after dietary fish meal replaced at a higher ratio [ 14 , 15 ].
statement: 单一的植物或动物蛋白源存在氨基酸组成不平衡和抗营养因子的缺点，在高比例替代鱼粉后常导致生长抑制、饲料利用率低和代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 单一的植物或动物蛋白源存在氨基酸组成不平衡和抗营养因子的缺点，在高比例替代鱼粉后常导致生长抑制、饲料利用率低和代谢紊乱。
text_en: Single plant or animal protein sources have the disadvantages of unbalanced amino acid composition and anti-nutritional factors. High-proportion replacement of fishmeal with these sources often leads to growth inhibition, low feed utilization, and metabolic disorders.
intervention: High-proportion single-source protein replacement of fishmeal
intervention_record: 单一蛋白源高比例替代鱼粉
outcome: 生长性能; 代谢健康

quote: However, at present, Chinese perch farming is mainly based on the combination of chilled fish and live bait [ 19 ], which not only pollutes the water environment but also makes it prone to disease outbreaks [ 20 ].
statement: 目前鳜鱼养殖主要基于冰鲜鱼和活饵的组合，这不仅污染水环境，而且容易导致疾病爆发。
text_zh: 目前鳜鱼养殖主要基于冰鲜鱼和活饵的组合，这不仅污染水环境，而且容易导致疾病爆发。
text_en: Currently, mandarin fish farming mainly relies on a combination of frozen fresh fish and live bait, which not only pollutes the water environment but also easily leads to disease outbreaks.
intervention: Combined frozen fish and live bait feeding
intervention_record: 冰鲜鱼与活饵组合投喂

quote: Research has shown that Chinese perch can be domesticated and fed on artificial formula feed through some special methods [ 21 ].
statement: 研究表明，通过一些特殊方法可以对鳜鱼进行驯化并喂食人工配合饲料。
text_zh: 研究表明，通过一些特殊方法可以对鳜鱼进行驯化并喂食人工配合饲料。
text_en: Studies have shown that Chinese perch can be acclimated and fed artificial compound feed through some special methods.

quote: The feeding period lasted for 56 days, with the fish fed to apparent satiation twice a day (6:00 and 18:00).
statement: 实验期间鱼类每天两次（6:00和18:00）饲喂至表观饱食，持续56天。
text_zh: 实验期间鱼类每天两次（6:00和18:00）饲喂至表观饱食，持续56天。
text_en: During the experimental period, fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 6:00 and 18:00) for 56 days.

quote: Water quality was tested regularly: temperature ranged 26–32°C, ammonia nitrogen was less than 0.1 mg/L, and the pH ranged 7.5–8.5.
statement: 定期检测水质，温度范围为26-32°C，氨氮低于0.1 mg/L，pH值范围为7.5-8.5。
text_zh: 定期检测水质，温度范围为26-32°C，氨氮低于0.1 mg/L，pH值范围为7.5-8.5。
text_en: Water quality is regularly monitored, with a temperature range of 26-32°C, ammonia nitrogen below 0.1 mg/L, and a pH range of 7.5-8.5.

quote: The water was continuously aerated to keep the dissolved oxygen at 7.0–9.3 mg/L.
statement: 水体连续曝气以维持溶解氧在7.0-9.3 mg/L之间。
text_zh: 水体连续曝气以维持溶解氧在7.0-9.3 mg/L之间。
text_en: Continuous aeration of the water body to maintain dissolved oxygen between 7.0-9.3 mg/L.

quote: After the breeding experiment, the fish were starved for 24 hr and then anesthetized with MS222 for weighing and counting.
statement: 养殖实验结束后，鱼禁食24小时，随后使用MS222麻醉进行称重和计数。
text_zh: 养殖实验结束后，鱼禁食24小时，随后使用MS222麻醉进行称重和计数。
text_en: After the aquaculture experiment ended, the fish were fasted for 24 hours, then weighed and counted using MS222 anesthesia.

quote: there were no significant differences in HSI, VSI, CF, FI, and SR between the experimental groups ( P 0.05).
statement: 实验组之间的肝体指数、脏体指数、肥满度、摄食量和存活率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 实验组之间的肝体指数、脏体指数、肥满度、摄食量和存活率没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in hepatosomatic index, viscerosomatic index, condition factor, feed intake, and survival rate between the experimental groups.

quote: There was no significant difference in WGR and SGR between the D2 and D1 groups ( P 0.05), but both were significantly higher than fish fed D3 ( P 0.05).
statement: D2组和D1组的增重率和特定生长率之间无显著差异，但均显著高于饲喂D3的鱼。
text_zh: D2组和D1组的增重率和特定生长率之间无显著差异，但均显著高于饲喂D3的鱼。
text_en: There was no significant difference in weight gain rate and specific growth rate between the D2 and D1 groups, but both were significantly higher than those of fish fed D3.

quote: The FCR of the D3 fish was significantly higher than that of fish fed both D1 and D2 ( P 0.05), and there was no significant difference in the FCR of fish from D1 and D2 groups ( P 0.05).
statement: D3鱼的饲料系数显著高于饲喂D1和D2的鱼，且D1和D2组鱼的饲料系数无显著差异。
text_zh: D3鱼的饲料系数显著高于饲喂D1和D2的鱼，且D1和D2组鱼的饲料系数无显著差异。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio of D3 fish was significantly higher than that of fish fed D1 and D2, and there was no significant difference in the feed conversion ratio between the D1 and D2 groups.
counterevidence: D3组饲料系数较高（效率较低）

quote: Remarkably, the positive cohesion was significantly improved in the D2 group, which was 1.4–1.8 times higher than that in the D1 and D3 groups.
statement: D2组的正内聚性显著改善，比D1和D3组高1.4-1.8倍。
text_zh: D2组的正内聚性显著改善，比D1和D3组高1.4-1.8倍。
text_en: The positive cohesiveness of the D2 group was significantly improved, being 1.4-1.8 times higher than that of the D1 and D3 groups.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落结构/相互作用

quote: The trial was conducted in pond cages with dimensions of 1.0 m × 1.0 m × 2 m with net cover.
statement: 试验在带有网盖的池塘网箱中进行，网箱尺寸为1.0米×1.0米×2米。
text_zh: 试验在带有网盖的池塘网箱中进行，网箱尺寸为1.0米×1.0米×2米。
text_en: The trial was conducted in pond cages with net covers, measuring 1.0 m × 1.0 m × 2 m.

quote: At the beginning of the experiment, the domesticated Chinese perch were starved for 24 hr, the physically robust evenly sized fish were distributed into nine groups and stocked in cages.
statement: 实验开始时，驯化的鳜鱼禁食24小时，体格健壮且大小均匀的鱼被分成九组并放入网箱中。
text_zh: 实验开始时，驯化的鳜鱼禁食24小时，体格健壮且大小均匀的鱼被分成九组并放入网箱中。
text_en: At the start of the experiment, domesticated mandarin fish were fasted for 24 hours, and healthy fish of uniform size were divided into nine groups and placed in net cages.

quote: Meanwhile, the abundance of Mycoplasma decreased to less than 0.1% in the substituted groups, with Cetobacterium dominating the microbial community (76.7%) ( Figure 1(c) ).
statement: 同时，在替代组中支原体的丰度降至0.1%以下，鲸杆菌主导了微生物群落（76.7%）。
text_zh: 同时，在替代组中支原体的丰度降至0.1%以下，鲸杆菌主导了微生物群落（76.7%）。
text_en: Meanwhile, in the replacement group, the abundance of Mycoplasma decreased to below 0.1%, and Cetobacterium dominated the microbial community (76.7%).

quote: In this study, replacing 27.27% fish meal with animal and plant complex proteins in the diets for Chinese perch had no adverse effect on the WGR and SGR.
statement: 在本研究中，用动物和植物复合蛋白替代27.27%的鱼粉对鳜鱼的体重增长率（WGR）和特定生长率（SGR）没有不利影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，用动物和植物复合蛋白替代27.27%的鱼粉对鳜鱼的体重增长率（WGR）和特定生长率（SGR）没有不利影响。
text_en: In this study, replacing 27.27% of fish meal with a composite protein from animal and plant sources had no adverse effect on the weight gain rate (WGR) and specific growth rate (SGR) of mandarin fish.

quote: Remarkably, the WGR and SGR of Chinese perch would significantly decreased when the substitution level reached 54.55%.
statement: 当替代水平达到54.55%时，鳜鱼的体重增长率（WGR）和特定生长率（SGR）显著下降。
text_zh: 当替代水平达到54.55%时，鳜鱼的体重增长率（WGR）和特定生长率（SGR）显著下降。
text_en: When the replacement level reached 54.55%, the weight gain rate (WGR) and specific growth rate (SGR) of mandarin fish decreased significantly.
